**Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most**At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.  

Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.  

**Do you have a passion for solving problems and understanding what customers need?**Are you interested in working in an evolving technical space where you bring in new ideas to help your customers transform and innovate their business? As a Solution Consultant, you will listen to the customer to understand their needs and create compelling business solution roadmaps — increasingly powered by AI.  

We look for individuals who have a proven track record of finding creative ways of solving complex problems. An out-of-the-box thinker who can drive customer success and build lasting relationships. As a technical ambassador of Genesys, you will be challenged to Go Big, showcasing the Genesys continuously evolving and innovative customer experience offering — including the latest in Genesys AI, from self-service and agent assistance to journey management and automation.  

**Why work for Genesys?**

- You will showcase your technical expertise and creative talents by developing and presenting dynamic demonstrations to executives, stakeholders and key influencers.
- You will have a unique opportunity to understand our customers' strategies and help them drive their business using our unique solutions.
- You will work at the forefront of AI in customer experience, helping customers understand and adopt capabilities such as LLM-powered virtual agents, agent copilots, and AI-driven orchestration.
- You will have flexibility and independence in designing your work.
- You will be able to access on-demand and in-person training.
- You will have internal resources you can call on to help you understand and solve technical challenges.
- You will have the ability to work closely with other brilliant individuals to collaboratively solve complex technical problems.

**What You Will Be Doing****Discover**You will run workshops with business users to uncover gaps and opportunities, define the projected benefits and present the outcomes to all stakeholders. You will lead technical discovery to identify where AI can improve customer experience, operational efficiency and measurable business outcomes.  

**Design**You will create customized demos and tell the story that showcases the solution. You will support solution designs for customer experience use cases — including self-service, agent assistance, journey management and back-office automation — that may combine LLMs, deterministic workflows, orchestration, fallback strategies and human handoff patterns. You will help customers ground AI responses in trusted enterprise data through knowledge and content strategies, and articulate trade-offs across accuracy, latency, cost and governance.  

**Demonstrate & Validate**You will build and deliver compelling technical demonstrations and presentations that explain AI capabilities, integration points and business impact. You will support sandbox and trial engagements, AI prototypes and value assessments that help customers validate use cases, integrations and success criteria — and partner with account teams and Professional Services to transition successful engagements toward production.  

**Learn & Share**You will stay up to date on Genesys products, Genesys AI capabilities and industry best practices, allowing you to continue advising the customer through the implementation process to ensure value. You will share field feedback and customer insights with Product Management, and contribute reusable assets and enablement content that help scale the broader team.  

**What do you need to have to be successful?**

- A passion for technology, AI and helping people solve problems.
- Interpersonal communication skills, with polished verbal and written communication — able to explain complex technical and AI concepts in clear business terms for both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including executive audiences.
- Ability to work in a fast-paced, cross-functional team environment; able to multitask, prioritize and be detail-oriented.
- Technological know-how of IT concepts, software standards, database and networking technologies.
- AI fluency: Working knowledge of AI in customer experience — such as NLU/NLP, LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), prompt design, and orchestration or agentic patterns — and the ability to position their business value.
- Integration & prototyping: Practical experience integrating cloud or AI solutions with enterprise platforms via RESTful APIs; familiarity with AI-assisted or agentic coding tools and scripting (e.g., Python, JavaScript) to accelerate demos, integrations and proofs of value is a strong asset.
- Ability to understand customers' security, governance and data-access needs and articulate a solution, including AI evaluation, quality measurement and monitoring considerations.
- Bachelor's degree or 5+ years of work experience; experience implementing or integrating with CRMs and/or software implementation or coding experience preferred.
- Experience working with a Cloud or SaaS company preferred; knowledge of Genesys Cloud and Genesys AI a strong asset.
- Sales acumen: Experience partnering with sales teams to understand customer challenges and provide technical solutioning that supports opportunity progression.
- Languages: Bilingualism (English and French). French is an asset but not required.
- Ability to travel up to 50%.

**Compensation:**This role has a market-competitive salary with an anticipated base compensation range listed below. Actual salaries will vary depending on a candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and location. This role might also be eligible for a commission or performance-based bonus opportunities.  

$124,600.00 - 163,600.00  

**Working at Genesys**

- AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year
- A flexible-first culture – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work
- Growth in the AI era – Build future-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support
- Time to recharge and give back – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families
- Recognized globally – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys

Learn more about our culture, AI innovation and sustainability commitments through our Careers site and Sustainability Report.  

**What Happens After You Apply**After you apply, here's what you can typically expect:  

- Our Talent Acquisition team reviews your application with the hiring team
- A Talent Acquisition Partner will review your application and, if your background is aligned, schedule a Zoom interview.
- Next, you'll meet the hiring manager and other members of the interview team
- We aim to keep the process focused and respectful of your time, with no more than five interviews in most cases
- After interviews are complete, our team will follow up with the final steps

Every application is reviewed by a person. Response times may vary by role and location, but our team will keep you informed throughout the process.  

**Stay Connected**Stay connected to learn more about how we're applying AI to customer and employee experience challenges and get notified when relevant opportunities become available.  

Get notified about relevant opportunities.  

**Be the one building what's next - where AI, experience and impact come together.****Employee Referral**If a Genesys employee referred you, please apply using the link they shared so we can connect your application to their referral.  

This is an active opening at Genesys. We use Artificial Intelligence to support the hiring process, but every application is reviewed by our Talent Acquisition team, looking beyond keywords to focus on your experience and potential.  

**About Genesys:**Genesys® empowers more than 8,000 organizations worldwide to create the best customer and employee experiences. Genesys Cloud™ is the Agentic Orchestration Platform that securely connects people, systems, data and AI across the enterprise with built-in governance and control. As a result, organizations can drive customer loyalty, growth and retention while increasing operational efficiency and teamwork across human and AI workforces. To learn more, visit www.genesys.ai.  

**Reasonable Accommodations:**If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in your ability to access or use this online application and need an alternative method for applying, you or someone you know may contact us at reasonable.accommodations@genesys.com.  

You can expect a response within 24–48 hours. To help us provide the best support, click the email link above to open a pre-filled message and complete the requested information before sending. If you have any questions, please include them in your email.  

This email is intended to support job seekers requesting accommodations. Messages unrelated to accommodation—such as application follow-ups or resume submissions—may not receive a response.  

**Genesys is an equal opportunity employer committed to fairness in the workplace. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, domestic partner status, national origin, genetics, disability, military and veteran status, and other protected characteristics.***Please note that recruiters will never ask for sensitive personal or financial information during the application phase.*

As one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, Fitch Ratings plays a critical role in global capital markets by providing credit analysis, ratings, research, and commentary to financial market participants. For over 100 years, Fitch Ratings has been creating value for global markets through its rigorous analysis and deep expertise, which have resulted in a variety of market leading tools, methodologies, indices, research, and analytical products. Fitch Ratings is part of Fitch Group, a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries, which also includes Fitch Solutions. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst.  

Join our fast growing Toronto innovation hub, where we’re building production grade AI to reshape global credit decisions. Here, you won’t just ship features—you’ll help reinvent an industry using decades deep proprietary data and a modern tech stack, free from heavy legacy. Backed by full enterprise support, you’ll build reliable, explainable intelligence at real scale within a collaborative, outcome driven community. If you’re looking for purposeful work, constant learning, and a place where your impact and growth accelerate—this is where you’ll thrive.  

Want to learn more about our Toronto Innovation Hub? Visit: https://careers.fitch.group/go/Toronto-Innovation-Hub/9713801/  

Fitch Ratings is currently seeking a Delivery Practice Owner, based out of our Toronto, Canada office.  

**About The Team**You will join the Delivery Management track within Technology & Data Delivery Enablement, leading Agile squad(s) to enable predictable, high-quality delivery. As a senior practitioner, you will partner with Tribe Leads, Technical Owners, Product, Engineering, Data, Finance, and business sponsors to evolve ways of working, mentor Delivery Owners, and contribute to enterprise delivery standards through our Communities of Practice.  

**How You’ll Make An Impact**End-to-End Squad Delivery  

- Enable delivery outcomes for your squad, ensuring predictable execution and high-quality delivery.
- Ensure the definition of ready/done and release criteria are consistently applied.
- Maintain squad-level accountability, modeling best practices within your assigned squad.
- Ensure the squad meets delivery commitments; drive predictability, throughput, and quality metrics.
- Facilitate strategic decisions and trade-offs with colleagues and senior leadership.
- Create transparency in delivery health; provide honest assessments and escalate risks with options and solutions.
- Mentor Delivery Owners through coaching and Agile leadership.

AI Enablement and Modern Practices  

- Drive adoption of AI-enabled delivery practices; mentor Delivery Owners on AI tool utilization.
- Identify and pilot new AI capabilities; share learnings with the Agile Delivery Center of Excellence.
- Champion AI literacy and responsible AI use within delivery management.
- Share learnings with peers and contribute to delivery practice evolution.

Operating Model and Enablement  

- Enable squad-level delivery rituals, escalation protocols, and forums rooted in Agile principles.
- Drive evidence-based planning and forecasting at the squad level.
- Keep roadmaps, backlogs, capacity plans, and forecasts synchronized and actionable.
- Lead retrospectives that identify systemic improvements; drive cross-squad improvement initiatives.
- Model accountability by owning delivery outcomes and transparently communicating status and risks.

Continuous Improvement and Evolution  

- Coach squad members on flow, predictability, and metrics; leverage modern practices to accelerate delivery.
- Foster a culture of experimentation and continuous improvement.

Center of Excellence Contribution  

- Lead initiatives within the Agile Delivery Center of Excellence.
- Develop delivery standards, playbooks, and best practices.
- Share innovations across the organization.
- Contribute to training programs and capability-building initiatives.

**You May Be a Good Fit If**

- You hold a bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, or a related field, or have equivalent experience.
- You have 6–8 years in Agile delivery, including 3+ years as a Delivery Owner or Scrum Master, with a proven track record delivering complex initiatives with measurable outcomes.
- You maintain Certified Scrum Master (CSM) and Certified Scrum Professional (CSP) or equivalent certifications.
- You demonstrate strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and experience mentoring delivery practitioners.

**What Would Make You Stand Out**

- Multiple advanced Agile certifications (e.g., CSP, SAFe, Kanban) and experience leading delivery transformation or AI enablement initiatives.
- Background in establishing delivery standards, playbooks, and Communities of Practice.
- Experience in financial services or regulated industries.

**Why Choose Fitch**

- Hybrid Work Environment: 3 days a week in office required.
- A Culture of Learning & Mobility: Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity.
- Investing in Your Future: Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long-term goals.
- Promoting Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing.
- Supportive Parenting Policies: Family-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively.
- Inclusive Work Environment: A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe.
- Dedication to Giving Back: Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community.

Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch’s credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interest or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Should you be successful in the recruitment process at Fitch Ratings you will be asked to declare any securities holdings and other potential conflicts prior to commencing employment. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself of them before beginning work.  

Equal Opportunity Employer Fitch is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran status, and other statuses protected by law.  

For Toronto roles only: Expected base pay rates for the role will be between 90,000 CAD and 120,000 CAD per year. Actual salaries will be determined on an individualized basis and may vary based on factors including but not limited to education, training, experience, past performance, and other job-related factors. Base pay is one part of Fitch’s total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, discretionary bonuses, long-term incentives, and other benefits sponsored by Fitch.

- Degree in Engineering, Environmental Science, Nuclear Science, or another related technical discipline.
- Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation is considered an asset.
- Minimum 10 years of progressive leadership experience within the nuclear industry or another highly regulated industrial environment.
- Demonstrated success leading complex technical programs, operations, or engineering teams.
- Experience developing strategic plans and executing large-scale operational initiatives.
- Proven experience managing budgets, resources, and multidisciplinary teams.

- Strong leadership and people management abilities.

As Canada’s premier private jet company with a legacy spanning over 70 years, **Execaire Aviation** leads the way in aviation solutions. Setting the standard in aviation excellence, we redefine the way you fly, ensuring unparallelled service and unforgettable experience. Our success is driven by a team of over 600 dedicated employees who all share the same vision. As a leading provider of aviation solutions and operators of private jets, we offer a complete range of services including aircraft management, aircraft maintenance, aircraft charter and sales, as well as FBO services. At **Execaire Aviation**, our foundation is built on unwavering core values. Safety is our compass, guiding every operation. Excellence is the standard we uphold in every task. Innovation is our driving force, propelling us into the future of aviation.  

Join us and be a part of a team that lives and breathes these values every day!  

**Summary**The Manager - Aviation Technical Services, is responsible for the strategic leadership, operational oversight, and regulatory compliance of the company's specialized technical service programs across its national and international network. This includes oversight of Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) services, In-Flight Entertainment and Connectivity (IFEC) support (Intelsat/Viasat), FedEx line maintenance support operations in Casper, Wyoming, aircraft potable water sampling programs, and other specialized technical services.  

The Manager will ensure these technical service lines operate safely, efficiently, and profitably while maintaining full compliance with Transport Canada, FAA, customer, and OEM requirements. The position is responsible for standardizing processes across multiple locations, managing technical personnel and subcontractors, developing new service offerings, and supporting business growth.  

This role serves as the company's subject matter expert for specialized technical services and works closely with Maintenance Operations, Quality Assurance, Airworthiness, Maintenance Control, Procurement, Sales, and customers to deliver high-quality maintenance support.  

**Responsibilities**   

- Operational Leadership

- Lead all Aviation Technical Services operations across the company's network.

technology_delivery:4444811182.description:
Do you want a role where you can improve the efficiency of large engineering teams across a broad range of areas? Then the Arm Solutions Engineering Chip Methodology and Automation (CMA) team is for you! The CMA team sits within Arm Solutions Engineering (SE) and develops tools, flows and methodologies deployed across all active SE projects. The team supports engineers in multiple sites including Canada (Toronto), US (Austin, Chandler and San Diego), UK (Manchester, Sheffield, Cambridge), India (Bangalore), France (Sophia), and Hungary (Budapest)!  

**Responsibilities**As a member of the CMA Applications Engineering team, you will work with others in the team on the deployment, training and support of our internal engineering flows, enabling efficient engineer ramp-up and use across our portfolio of solutions, enabling project teams for execution success.  

Working with engineers on Arm projects in conjunction with the CMA Design Methodology & Verification Methodology developers you will help ensure our front-end Design and Verification flows are meeting the expected criteria and are operating as intended. You will provide training, ramp new teams in Arm and help influence the direction and development of our tools, flows and methodologies through your knowledge of the usage patterns across the teams. You will also work with EDA vendors when teams find issues with EDA tooling and ensure that provided solutions reach resolution.  

The flows you will support could include verification flows related to simulation, formal verification, power-aware simulation, gate level simulation, or design tooling such as lint, CDC/RDC, SDC, and how they deliver into back-end flows covering the full implementation life-cycle. You will also look at the overall efficiency and effectiveness of our project teams to determine where there could be new solutions developed to make the project-based engineering community work more effectively.  

**Required Skills And Experience**

- Knowledge of Design or Verification flows used in SoC development, with an awareness of other aspects of SoC development
- Skilled in a scripting language such as python and flows used for version control such as git, gerrit
- Knowledge of databases and their application to engineering flows
- Excellent communication skills.

****“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience:****

- Experience working on global IP and SoC development projects

****In Return:****Arm is a global, diverse organization of dedicated, innovative, and highly capable people. We believe great ideas come from a vibrant and inclusive workplace where everyone can grow, succeed, and share their outstanding contributions! You will join a multi-cultural team with varied skills and experience. You will have access to a huge variety of technologies and systems to learn and will be supported every step of the way!  

**Additional Information**Please note that no relocation package is available for this role.  

****Salary Range:**** $99,900-$135,100 per year  

We value people as individuals and our dedication is to reward people competitively and equitably for the work they do and the skills and experience they bring to Arm. Salary is only one component of Arm's offering. The total reward package will be shared with candidates during the recruitment and selection process.  

****Accommodations at Arm****At Arm, we want to build extraordinary teams. If you need an adjustment or an accommodation during the recruitment process, please email accommodations@arm.com . To note, by sending us the requested information, you consent to its use by Arm to arrange for appropriate accommodations. All accommodation or adjustment requests will be treated with confidentiality, and information concerning these requests will only be disclosed as necessary to provide the accommodation. Although this is not an exhaustive list, examples of support include breaks between interviews, having documents read aloud, or office accessibility. Please email us about anything we can do to accommodate you during the recruitment process.  

****Hybrid Working at Arm****Arm’s approach to hybrid working is designed to create a working environment that supports both high performance and personal wellbeing. We believe in bringing people together face to face to enable us to work at pace, whilst recognizing the value of flexibility. Within that framework, we empower groups/teams to determine their own hybrid working patterns, depending on the work and the team’s needs. Details of what this means for each role will be shared upon application. In some cases, the flexibility we can offer is limited by local legal, regulatory, tax, or other considerations, and where this is the case, we will collaborate with you to find the best solution. Please talk to us to find out more about what this could look like for you.  

****Equal Opportunities at Arm****Arm is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal opportunities are available to all applicants and colleagues. We are a diverse organization of dedicated and innovative individuals, and don’t discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

technology_delivery:4445241878.description:
BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.  

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.  

The Role  

BeyondTrust is seeking a Senior Software Development Manager to lead the team driving the evolution of the NHI Governance domain within our Pathfinder products. You will build, grow, and lead a high-performing engineering team responsible for delivering a new platform-native module and the scalable, secure, and extensible services that power our SaaS offerings; helping customers discover, assess, and remediate non-human identities (service accounts, workload identities, secrets and keys, and AI agents) across cloud and on-premise environments. This role blends people leadership, delivery ownership, and technical judgment: you will set the bar for execution and quality while developing engineers and partnering across product, design, and platform teams to solve complex identity and security challenges at scale.  

What You’ll Do  

- Experience leading and managing software engineering teams building cloud-based or SaaS products.
- A strong technical foundation, with the ability to engage credibly in architecture, design, and code-level trade-offs.
- Experience leading teams that use AI-assisted, agentic development tools such as Claude Code, and foster their effective and responsible adoption.
- Proven track record of delivering complex projects on schedule and at a high-quality bar.
- Experience partnering with product and design in an agile delivery environment.
- Familiarity with modern cloud-native development, microservices, and public cloud providers (AWS preferred).
- Experience developing engineers and growing talent through coaching and mentorship.
- Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to drive clarity and direction amid ambiguity.
- Excellent communication skills, able to bridge technical and business needs across cross-functional teams.

Nice To Have  

- Domain experience in identity security: IAM, NHI/Secrets, cloud IAM (AWS IAM, Microsoft Entra ID), OAuth/OIDC.
- Experience delivering multi-tenant shared platform services consumed by other engineering teams.
- Experience leading a team through a 0-to-1 module or domain build.

Who You Are  

- A people-first leader who takes ownership of team outcomes and grows engineers.
- A bar-raiser for delivering results and relentlessly pursuing high quality.
- Someone who balances technical excellence with pragmatic decision-making, ensuring security without unnecessary complexity.
- A strong communicator, able to bridge technical and business needs in cross-team and cross-functional discussions.
- A builder of healthy, inclusive, high-trust teams.

Better Together  

Diversity. Inclusion. They’re more than just words for us. They are the guiding values of how we build our teams, cultivate leaders, and create a culture where people feel connected.  

We take care of our employees so they can take care of our customers. Customers who come from all walks of life just like us. We hire incredible people from diverse backgrounds because when we are different together, we are stronger together.  

**About Us**BeyondTrust is the global identity security leader protecting Paths to Privilege™. Our identity-centric approach goes beyond securing privileges and access, empowering organizations with the most effective solution to manage the entire identity attack surface and neutralize threats, whether from external attacks or insiders.  

BeyondTrust is leading the charge in transforming identity security to prevent breaches and limit the blast radius of attacks, while creating a superior customer experience and operational efficiencies. We are trusted by 20,000 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 100, and our global ecosystem of partners.  

Learn more at www.beyondtrust.com.

technology_delivery:4445258802.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.  

Lyft connects people to transportation to change the way we live and get around our communities. We are looking for product managers who bring exceptional creative and analytical skills to drive forward a best in class product. Product management at Lyft leads the integration of engineering, data science, and design to achieve the company's vision for reinventing transportation. We are looking for entrepreneurial and passionate Product Managers to innovate and execute across a rapidly growing, fast paced company and industry from our Toronto office.  

Every great support experience depends on the person behind it having the right tools, context, and intelligence to solve the problem in front of them. The Platform & Data teams build the tools our human support agents work in every day—and own the data that tells Lyft, and the world, what our customers are actually experiencing. As AI rapidly changes what's possible, we're reinventing how agents work: pairing them with copilots and AI that surface the right answer instantly, take on repetitive work, and raise the quality and consistency of every interaction. At the same time, we're building the data foundation that turns millions of support contacts into an accurate, trusted view of issue types and trends—used inside the team, across the company, and in what we report externally. This role owns that mandate end to end: setting the vision and strategy, and driving execution on the hardest problems across both the platform and its data.  

**Responsibilities:**

- Own the vision, strategy, and multi-quarter roadmap for Lyft's agent platform and the data that powers customer care & safety reporting
- Define and drive how AI and copilot capabilities make agents more efficient and raise the quality and consistency of their work
- Lead execution on the most complex, cross-cutting initiatives across the platform and its data
- Own the accuracy and integrity of customer care & safety data so it can be trusted for internal decisions, company-wide use, and external reporting on issue types and trends
- Shape how the platform is architected, configured, and operated as agent workflows and AI capabilities evolve
- Partner deeply with engineering, data science, ML, design, and support operations to turn strategy into shipped product
- Serve as the senior product voice on agent platform and data, aligning stakeholders and executives around a clear direction
- Define the metrics that matter and use them to prioritize and measure real-world impact

**Experience:**

- 8+ years of product management experience, including owning the vision and strategy for a platform or a complex, cross-functional product area
- Direct experience with AI/ML-powered products—ideally copilots, agent-assist, or LLM-based tooling—with a real understanding of their capabilities and limits
- Strong data fluency: you've owned or worked closely with data pipelines, data quality, and reporting, and you care about getting the numbers right
- A track record of driving execution on ambiguous, high-complexity problems that span multiple teams and systems
- Comfortable operating with autonomy and influencing senior stakeholders without direct authority
- Strengths:

- Customer obsession: You care deeply about the support experience and dive into the details of customer and agent problems
- Technical depth: You engage credibly with engineers and understand platform + AI/ML/LLM capabilities, limitations, and emerging developments
- Data rigor: You treat data as a product—accurate, well-defined, and trustworthy enough to report externally
- Strategic ownership: You set direction, not just execute against it, and bring others along
- Bias to action: You break down complex problems, build elegant solutions, and move quickly to deploy them at scale

- Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Math, or equivalent technical experience strongly preferred

**Benefits:**

- Extended health and dental coverage options, along with life insurance and disability benefits
- Mental health benefits
- Family building benefits
- Child care and pet benefits
- Access to a Lyft funded Health Care Savings Account
- RRSP plan with company match to help save for your future
- In addition to provincial observed holidays, salaried team members are covered under Lyft's flexible paid time off policy. The policy allows team members to take off as much time as they need (with manager approval). Hourly team members get 15 days paid time off, with an additional day for each year of service
- Lyft is proud to support new parents with 18 weeks of paid time off, designed as a top-up plan to complement provincial programs. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible.
- Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

Lyft is committed to creating an inclusive workforce that fosters belonging. Lyft believes that every person has a right to equal employment opportunities without discrimination because of race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, family status, disability, pardoned record of offences, or any other basis protected by applicable law or by Company policy. Lyft also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind. Accommodation for persons with disabilities will be provided upon request in accordance with applicable law during the application and hiring process. Please contact your recruiter if you wish to make such a request.  

Lyft highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office at least 3 days per week, including on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. #Hybrid  

The expected base pay range for this position in the Toronto area is CAD $172,000 - CAD $215,000, not inclusive of potential equity offering, bonus or benefits. **Expert, Architecture de l’information**Au CN, chaque jour apporte de nouveaux défis stimulants. Vous évoluerez dans un milieu intéressant où vous contribuerez au déroulement sécuritaire et efficace de nos activités et aiderez à maintenir l’économie sur la bonne voie. Nous offrons les programmes de formation rémunérés et les possibilités sur lesquelles reposent les carrières à long terme, et nous soulignons le travail acharné des employés qui s’efforcent de changer les choses. Vous pourrez vous épanouir dans notre culture unifiée axée sur la sécurité, où nous travaillons ensemble comme UNE ÉQUIPE. Nous offrons des carrières valorisantes car notre travail fait une différence. Embarquez avec nous!  

**Résumé des fonctions** **L’expert ou l’experte Architecture d’information doit s’assurer, par l’entremise de modèles, de normes, de technologies et de processus, que l’information est gérée comme un actif stratégique, de la même manière que le matériel ferroviaire du CN. La personne titulaire de ce poste détermine, organise, structure et définit, de manière efficace et durable, les entités commerciales qui sont importantes pour l’entreprise.**   **Principales responsabilités**

- Comprendre les activités du CN et les convertir en une architecture d’information
- Élaborer, fournir, mettre à jour, communiquer et régir la stratégie, les normes, les directives, les cadres et les modèles s’appliquant à l’architecture d’information
- Déterminer et combler les écarts entre les modèles conceptuels de solution et le modèle d’information d’affaires (BIM), ainsi que les écarts entre les modèles logiques de solution et le modèle de données logiques de l’entreprise
- Communiquer les livrables par l’entremise de l’équipe Génie logiciel, et appuyer la conception de modèles de données physiques
- Assurer l’harmonisation des normes, des politiques, de la solution, des technologies et de l’architecture de l’entreprise
- Participer aux réunions périodiques pertinentes du groupe Architecture
- Collaborer avec d’autres architectes et les guider en vue d’établir un modèle de gouvernance globale de manière à s’assurer que les solutions sont élaborées conformément à l’architecture d’information en place
- Concevoir et diriger le modèle de données de même que l’architecture globale des données
- Concevoir les processus de gouvernance et déterminer les exigences en matière de données afin de soutenir la logique commerciale d’une solution
- Définir le cadre, les normes et les principes de l’architecture de données, y compris la modélisation, les métadonnées, la sécurité, les données de référence, les données de base, les versions, la traçabilité et le cycle des données
- Diriger les discussions portant sur l’architecture de même que les exercices relatifs à la conception afin de former les équipes quant aux pratiques exemplaires relatives à la gestion des données
- Établir les hiérarchies en matière d’information de même que les flux de contenus
- Concevoir des données conceptuelles, des données logiques et des modèles de processus commerciaux
- Définir les politiques, les procédures et les modèles à utiliser pour la cueillette, l’organisation, le stockage et l’accès aux informations

 **Exigences**Architecture d’information  

- Au moins 10 ans d’expérience sur le marché du travail
- Expérience d’au moins 5 ans démontrant des qualités de leader technique ou en supervision de livrables
- De 7 à 10 ans d’expérience dans un poste similaire
- Expérience en compréhension, conception et mise en œuvre d’architectures d’information permettant de bien intégrer des systèmes interactifs, collaboratifs et analytiques
- Expérience de différents types et techniques de modélisation d’information au niveau d’une entreprise
- Inspirer les autres par des communications efficaces et s’adapter à l’auditoire à l’oral et à l’écrit
- Utiliser le raisonnement analytique
- Innover par la résolution de problèmes
- Connaître l’entreprise et être à l’affût des tendances du secteur pour développer son expertise et mieux accomplir son travail
- Faire preuve d’un bon sens de l’organisation
- Collaborer avec les principaux intervenants internes pour accroître la productivité
- Être en mesure de travailler de manière autonome avec peu de supervision

 **Connaissances et compétences techniques**

- Compréhension des taxonomies et des ontologies, ainsi que des défis liés à l’application de techniques structurées (modélisation de données) à des sources moins structurées
- Connaissance de base de l’information stratégique, du stockage des données, des systèmes de gestion des bases de données relationnelles et non relationnelles et d’autres structures de données
- Connaissance des outils tels que Enterprise Architect de Sparx, Erwin et Visio de Microsoft\*
- Connaissance du secteur du transport ferroviaire ou du secteur de la logistique\*
- Connaissance des pratiques exemplaires et des plus récentes tendances en matière de pratiques d’architecture d’information (p. ex., Non-Structured Query Language [NoSQL], Gestion des données de base [GDB], Mégadonnées)\*
- Toute connaissance dans l’un des domaines ci-dessus constitue un atout

**Formation, certification et désignation**

- Baccalauréat en informatique, en systèmes d’information ou expérience équivalente de projets connexes

À propos du CN  

En tant que chef de file dans les domaines du transport et de la logistique en Amérique du Nord, nous sommes un véritable pilier de l’économie. Forts d’une équipe d’environ 25 000 cheminots, nous avons pour priorité de faire progresser notre entreprise et l’économie. Nous transportons annuellement des marchandises d’une valeur de 200 G$ US pour un large éventail de secteurs, tels les ressources naturelles, les produits manufacturés et les biens de consommation, sur un réseau de 20 000 milles qui couvre le Canada et le centre des États-Unis. Le CN est la seule entreprise canadienne à figurer dans la catégorie du secteur du transport et de l’infrastructure du transport du Dow Jones Sustainability Index (DJSI) World. Créé en 1999, l’indice DJSI World est l’indice de référence en ce qui a trait au développement durable. Au CN, nous travaillons comme UNE ÉQUIPE axée sur la sécurité et nos clients, offrant l’excellence sur le plan de l’exploitation et de la chaîne d’approvisionnement pour produire des résultats.  

**À propos de CN**Le CN est un chemin de fer de premier plan qui génère de la valeur de manière durable pour nos clients, actionnaires, employés et parties prenantes, avec un engagement indéfectible envers la sécurité et le service. Essentiel à l'économie, aux clients et aux communautés qu'il dessert, le CN transporte chaque année plus de 300 millions de tonnes de ressources naturelles, de produits manufacturés et de produits finis en toute sécurité partout en Amérique du Nord. Le vaste réseau ferroviaire du CN s'étend sur plus de 30 000 km (près de 20 000 milles), reliant les côtes est et ouest du Canada au sud des États-Unis. Depuis 1919, CN et ses affiliés contribuent à la prospérité des communautés et au commerce durable. Le CN propulse l'économie nord-américaine et s'engage dans des programmes de responsabilité sociale et de gestion environnementale.  

Au CN, nous sommes déterminés à bâtir le chemin de fer **le plus sûr** , le plus **inclusif** et le plus **durable** en Amérique du Nord, à l'image des collectivités dans lesquelles nous exerçons nos activités. Les études montrent que les candidats hésitent souvent à postuler s'ils estiment ne pas répondre à 100 % aux exigences du poste. À tous les candidats potentiels : même si vous ne répondez pas à toutes les exigences énoncées dans l'affichage d'un poste, nous vous encourageons quand même à poser votre candidature.  

Si vous avez besoin d'un accommodement pour le processus de recrutement (y compris des formats alternatifs de documents, des salles de réunion accessibles ou d'autres accommodements), veuillez contacter notre équipe à l'adresse suivante : **cnrecruitment@cn.ca** .  

À titre d'employeur souscrivant au principe de l'égalité d'accès à l'emploi, le CN prendra en considération pour un emploi tous les candidats qualifiés sans égard à la race, à la couleur, à la religion, au sexe, à l'orientation sexuelle, à l'identité de genre, à l'origine nationale, à l'invalidité, au statut d'ancien combattant protégé, et à tout autre statut protégé en vertu des lois applicables.  

Veuillez consulter régulièrement vos courriels, car les communications aux candidats sont envoyées par courrier électronique.

**Extraordinary Teams Building Inspiring Projects**Since 1898, we have helped customers complete more than 25,000 projects in 160 countries on all seven continents that have created jobs, grown economies, improved the resiliency of the world's infrastructure, increased access to energy, resources, and vital services, and made the world a safer, cleaner place.  

Differentiated by the quality of our people and our relentless drive to deliver the most successful outcomes, we align our capabilities to our customers' objectives to create a lasting positive impact. We serve the Infrastructure; Nuclear, Security & Environmental; Energy; Mining & Metals, and the Manufacturing and Technology markets. Core to Bechtel is our Vision, Values and Commitments. They are what we believe, what customers can expect, and how we deliver. Learn more about our extraordinary teams building inspiring projects in our Impact Report.  

**Project Overview**Bechtel Infrastructure will work in a Delivery Partner role within an integrated team with the customer organization for a Subway Project in Toronto, Ontario. The project scope includes the design build, operations and maintenance of all infrastructure and rail systems associated with 15 stations and over 15km of new alignment, being performed by three key PPP Contractors and multiple advanced early works (EAW) packages Contractors. Bechtel form a key component of the overall Integrated Project Delivery team (comprising the customer, MX; the Technical Advisor, and Bechtel as the Delivery Partner).  

**Job Summary**In the role of Systems Delivery Project Manager RSSOM (Rolling Stock, Systems, and O&M), you will be responsible for oversight of engineering and construction services throughout the project lifecycle and accountable to ensure designs meet the delivery/constructability need of construction. You will also be responsible for construction readiness and supervision, making sure that the contractor is meeting their contract and schedule management, construction quality, site safety, and security requirements.  

**Major Responsibilities****Leadership / Supervision**

- Delivers project from initial conception and procurement through commissioning and handovers within scope, on budget and on schedule, in accordance with good project management and construction practices.
- Manages complex project issues and risks, facilitates effective conflict resolution, communicates with internal and external stakeholders, and manages their expectations.
- Manages the efficient delivery of project elements through project activities, including preliminary design, detailed design, construction, contract management, and commissioning activities.
- Carries out robust assessment of the contractor schedule and supervises the development of risk assessments and robust mitigation measures.

- Monitors objectives related to engineering progress, document control, budget, and work breakdown structures, project schedules, resource prioritization, and staffing requirements.

- Drives a Zero Incident Philosophy within team and wider project.
- Collaborates with the contractor to implement H&S best practices and initiatives. Drives the safety culture on the project.
- Monitors implementation of the Contractor’s quality program(s). Monitors the Contractor’s quality assurance activities to ensure materials and equipment comply with design plans and specifications.

**Technical**

- Assists the development and assessment of alternative construction and installation methodologies in accordance with best international practices.
- Monitors the contractor’s performance and compliance with the contract.
- Prepares and monitors the strategic goals and objectives of the project.

**Education And Experience Requirements**

- Requires bachelor's or master's degree (or international equivalent) and 13-15 years of relevant experience or 17-19 years of relevant work experience.

**Required Knowledge And Skills**

- Similar railway metro project in an urban environment.
- General experience and knowledge of railway systems installation – Traction Power, Signalling, Communications (Fibre, CCTV, PA), SCADA, and Platform Screen Doors.
- Experience in planning and execution of systems installation.

**Total Rewards/Benefits**For decades, Bechtel has worked to inspire the next generation of employees and beyond! Whether it is advancing careers, delivering programs to enhance our culture, or providing time to recharge, Bechtel has the benefits to build a legacy of sustainable growth. We are committed to being a company where every colleague feels that they belong-where colleagues feel part of "One Team," respected and rewarded for what they bring, supported in pursuing their goals, invested in our values and purpose, and treated equitably. Click here to learn more about the people who power our legacy.

**About Leyad**

Leyad is a Montreal-based real estate investment and management firm with a diverse portfolio of residential, commercial, and industrial properties across Canada. For over a decade, we have focused on creating long-term value through strategic, sustainable investments and a commitment to excellence. Our success stems from our ability to identify opportunities where others see challenges and consistently deliver strong results for our clients and tenants.

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced **Senior Construction Project Manager** to join our growing construction team. In this role, you will be responsible for leading multiple commercial construction projects across Canada from pre-construction through project completion. You will oversee all aspects of project delivery, including budgeting, scheduling, procurement, contract administration, stakeholder management, and consultant coordination, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

This position is ideal for an experienced professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment, can manage multiple priorities independently, and possesses strong leadership and communication skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Manage multiple commercial construction projects simultaneously across Canada.
- Lead projects through all phases, including planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and close-out.
- Develop and maintain detailed project schedules, budgets, cash flow forecasts, and risk registers.
- Coordinate and manage architects, engineers, consultants, contractors, and other project stakeholders.
- Prepare tender packages, lead procurement activities, evaluate bids, negotiate contracts, and oversee contract awards.
- Administer construction contracts and monitor contractor performance throughout the project lifecycle.
- Identify project risks and implement proactive mitigation strategies.
- Monitor project costs, review change orders, approve invoices, and ensure financial accountability.
- Conduct regular site visits to monitor construction progress, quality, safety, and compliance with project requirements.
- Ensure projects comply with applicable building codes, regulations, and company standards.
- Prepare and present project status reports to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with internal teams, consultants, contractors, municipalities, and ownership groups.
- Mentor and support junior project managers and project coordinators as required.
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives within project management processes and construction operations.

**Qualifications**

- Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Architecture, Engineering, or a related field.
- 8–10+ years of commercial construction project management experience.
- Owner-side or construction consulting experience is preferred.
- Proven experience managing multiple large-scale commercial construction projects simultaneously.
- Strong knowledge of construction methods, procurement processes, tendering, contract administration, scheduling, and budgeting.
- Experience working with CCDC contracts and industry-standard construction documentation.
- Excellent leadership, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
- Strong financial acumen with experience managing project budgets and cost controls.
- Exceptional organizational, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
- Ability to work independently while managing competing priorities and deadlines.
- Willingness to travel regularly throughout Canada.

**Why Join Leyad**

At Leyad, you'll join a collaborative and forward-thinking team that values integrity, innovation, and excellence. As a Senior Construction Project Manager, you'll play an integral role in supporting the successful delivery of commercial construction projects across Canada. Working alongside experienced Project Managers and industry professionals, you'll gain hands-on experience coordinating projects from planning through completion while contributing to the continued growth and success of our national real estate portfolio. This is an excellent opportunity to further develop your project management skills in a dynamic and supportive environment.

**À propos de Leyad**

Leyad est une société montréalaise spécialisée dans l’investissement et la gestion immobilière, possédant un portefeuille diversifié de propriétés résidentielles, commerciales et industrielles partout au Canada. Depuis plus de dix ans, nous nous consacrons à la création de valeur à long terme grâce à des investissements stratégiques et durables ainsi qu’à un engagement envers l’excellence. Notre succès repose sur notre capacité à repérer des occasions là où d’autres voient des défis, tout en offrant constamment des résultats exceptionnels à nos clients et locataires.

**Sommaire du poste**

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) **Gestionnaire principal(e) de projets de construction** expérimenté(e) pour se joindre à notre équipe de construction en pleine croissance. Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de diriger plusieurs projets de construction commerciale à travers le Canada, de la phase de préconstruction jusqu’à la livraison finale. Vous superviserez tous les aspects de l’exécution des projets, notamment la gestion des budgets, des échéanciers, des approvisionnements, de l’administration des contrats, des relations avec les parties prenantes et de la coordination des consultants, afin d’assurer la réalisation des projets de façon sécuritaire, dans les délais, selon le budget établi et conformément aux plus hauts standards de qualité.

Ce poste convient à un(e) professionnel(le) d’expérience qui s’épanouit dans un environnement dynamique, est capable de gérer plusieurs priorités de façon autonome et possède d’excellentes aptitudes en leadership et en communication.

**Principales responsabilités**

- Gérer simultanément plusieurs projets de construction commerciale partout au Canada.
- Diriger les projets à toutes les étapes, y compris la planification, la conception, l’approvisionnement, la construction, la mise en service et la clôture des projets.
- Élaborer et maintenir des échéanciers détaillés, des budgets, des prévisions de trésorerie et des registres des risques.
- Coordonner et gérer les architectes, ingénieurs, consultants, entrepreneurs et autres intervenants du projet.
- Préparer les documents d’appel d’offres, diriger les activités d’approvisionnement, évaluer les soumissions, négocier les contrats et superviser leur attribution.
- Administrer les contrats de construction et assurer le suivi du rendement des entrepreneurs tout au long du cycle de vie des projets.
- Identifier les risques liés aux projets et mettre en œuvre des stratégies d’atténuation proactives.
- Assurer le suivi des coûts, examiner les ordres de changement, approuver les factures et veiller au contrôle financier des projets.
- Effectuer des visites régulières sur les chantiers afin de surveiller l’avancement des travaux, la qualité, la sécurité et la conformité aux exigences des projets.
- Veiller au respect des codes du bâtiment, des règlements applicables et des normes de l’entreprise.
- Préparer et présenter des rapports d’avancement des projets à la haute direction et aux principales parties prenantes.
- Établir et maintenir d’excellentes relations avec les équipes internes, les consultants, les entrepreneurs, les municipalités et les groupes de propriétaires.
- Encadrer et soutenir les gestionnaires de projets et coordonnateurs de projets juniors, au besoin.
- Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des processus de gestion de projets et des opérations de construction.

**Qualifications**

- Baccalauréat en gestion de la construction, en génie civil, en architecture, en génie ou dans un domaine connexe.
- De 8 à 10 ans ou plus d’expérience en gestion de projets de construction commerciale.
- Une expérience du côté du propriétaire (owner-side) ou en consultation en construction constitue un atout.
- Expérience démontrée dans la gestion simultanée de plusieurs projets de construction commerciale d’envergure.
- Excellente connaissance des méthodes de construction, des processus d’approvisionnement, des appels d’offres, de l’administration des contrats, de la planification des projets et de la gestion budgétaire.
- Expérience de travail avec les contrats **CCDC** et la documentation normalisée de l’industrie de la construction.
- Excellentes aptitudes en leadership, en négociation et en gestion des parties prenantes.
- Solide sens des affaires et expérience en gestion des budgets de projets et du contrôle des coûts.
- Excellentes capacités d’organisation, d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes.
- Capacité à travailler de façon autonome tout en gérant des priorités concurrentes et des échéances serrées.
- Disponibilité pour voyager régulièrement partout au Canada.

**Pourquoi se joindre à Leyad**

Chez Leyad, vous ferez partie d'une équipe collaborative et tournée vers l'avenir qui valorise l'intégrité, l'innovation et l'excellence. À titre deGestionnaire principal(e) de projets de construction, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la réalisation de projets de construction commerciale partout au Canada. En travaillant aux côtés de gestionnaires de projets expérimentés et de professionnels de l'industrie, vous dirigerez des projets d'envergure, de la planification jusqu'à leur achèvement, tout en contribuant à la croissance continue et au succès de notre portefeuille immobilier national. Il s'agit d'une excellente occasion de mettre à profit votre expertise en gestion de projets au sein d'un environnement dynamique, stimulant et axé sur la collaboration.

**About Compugen**Compugen is Canada's largest privately-owned Technology Ally. To innovate industries, transform businesses, connect communities, and drive meaningful change, we must think bigger, reach broader, and act bolder. Through knowledge, curiosity, and collaboration, Compugen helps organizations delivering experience by design. This is what it means to be human-centered and technology-enabled.  

Dreaming, designing, and delivering isn't just a mantra for us — it's a way of life. We believe that technology is the conduit, but our people – they are the connection that truly makes the magic happen!  

 **Our Culture**We are a human-centered culture where we prioritize your well-being and are invested in helping you reach your fullest potential. We're not only focused on achieving our goals — we're dedicated to helping you achieve yours.  

If you're relentlessly curious, driven to make a difference, and collaborative at the core, then you belong with us.  

 **Position Overview:**We are seeking a dynamic, technically credible, and client-focused Senior Delivery Manager with deep experience in managed services, IT operations, and management consulting. This role leads end-to-end service delivery across a portfolio of enterprise clients and requires the ability to operate equally well with technical teams, service leaders, and senior executives.  

The successful candidate will bring strong practical knowledge of shared service desk operations, cloud and hybrid infrastructure, end-user services, ITSM, and general enterprise technology. They will ensure service performance, guide technical and operational decisions, drive continuous improvement, and advise client leaders on how technology services should evolve to support business outcomes, transformation priorities, risk reduction, and growth.  

**Key Responsibilities:** **Client Relationship, Consulting & Governance**

- Act as the senior point of contact and trusted advisor for managed services clients.
- Lead executive-level discussions, quarterly business reviews (QBRs), and governance forums.
- Provide strategic consulting to align IT services with client transformation objectives, roadmaps, and KPIs.
- Identify business challenges and collaborate with internal SMEs to design tailored service and technology solutions.
- Serve as a credible bridge between executives and technical teams, ensuring recommendations are operationally realistic, technically sound, and aligned to business priorities.

 **Service Delivery and Operations**

- Manage the delivery of shared service desk, end-user computing, cloud, infrastructure, application, network, security, and other managed IT services.
- Ensure reliable and secure service performance through strong SLA, KPI, experience-level, capacity, availability, incident, problem, and contract governance.
- Lead technical and operational reviews, root cause analysis, service stabilization, automation, continuous improvement, and quality initiatives.

 **Technical Leadership & Advisory**

- Provide senior technical oversight across shared service desk, cloud, infrastructure, end-user computing, networks, security, applications, monitoring, and service management platforms.
- Assess service architectures, support models, operational processes, tooling, technical risks, and dependencies to identify gaps and improvement opportunities.
- Guide incident recovery, major problem resolution, service stabilization, technical remediation, and modernization priorities without replacing the accountability of architects or engineering specialists.
- Evaluate proposed solutions and technical roadmaps for scalability, supportability, security, resilience, cost, and alignment with the client’s operating model.
- Coach delivery managers and technical leads on effective service management, technical governance, client communication, and data-driven decision-making.

 **Consulting-Focused Initiatives**

- Guide clients through operational and technical maturity assessments, service optimization roadmaps, cloud and infrastructure modernization, and digital transformation initiatives.
- Collaborate with architects, technical SMEs, consulting, and sales teams to shape and execute practical technology solutions, transformation programs, and operating-model changes.
- Translate complex technical issues, risks, dependencies, and investment choices into clear recommendations for business and technology leaders.

 **Team & Vendor Management**

- Lead cross-functional teams including service desk leaders, service delivery leads, cloud and infrastructure specialists, consultants, architects, and technical SMEs.
- Manage partner and vendor relationships, ensuring aligned delivery and governance.
- Develop high-performing teams through coaching, knowledge sharing, and leadership.
- Demonstrate strong people leadership by inspiring, developing, and empowering teams to achieve high performance, foster collaboration, and drive organizational success.

 **Financial & Commercial Oversight**

- Own account-level P&L, budget planning, and resource allocation.
- Support renewals, expansions, and transformation engagements by identifying growth opportunities.
- Ensure contractual obligations and change requests are well-managed and documented.

 **Skills & Qualifications:****Required**

- 10+ years of progressive experience in managed services, IT operations, service delivery, technical consulting, or technology leadership within an IT Services environment.
- Demonstrated experience leading complex client environments while providing management consulting, business advisory, technology strategy, or strategic account leadership.
- Strong practical understanding of ITIL/ITSM, shared service desk operations, incident and problem management, SLA governance, service integration, and continual service improvement.
- Broad technical knowledge across cloud platforms, hybrid infrastructure, networks, cybersecurity, end-user computing, applications, monitoring, automation, and enterprise support models.
- Proven ability to challenge, influence, and guide senior business and technology stakeholders while maintaining strong executive presence and communication skills.

 **Preferred**

- Hands-on or leadership experience with Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP; Microsoft 365; hybrid infrastructure; and modern service management platforms.
- Experience managing or transforming shared service desk, cloud, infrastructure, end-user, application, network, or cybersecurity services.
- Certifications: ITIL Foundation required; Azure, AWS, Microsoft, ServiceNow, PMP, CSM, COBIT, or advanced ITIL certifications are strong assets.
- Bachelor’s degree in business, Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; MBA or management consulting experience is a strong asset.

 **What Compugen Offers You:**

- Exciting, fast-paced challenging work environment
- A culture where authenticity and diversity are valued
- Professional development
- Participation in Women in Technology Network
- Opportunities to give back to our local communities
- Collaborative supportive team members
- Remote work/hybrid work options
- Work/life flexibility

**Position:** Head of Engineering, Switchgear

**Function:** Manufacturing & Operations  

**Location:** Langley, BC, Canada  

**The Opportunity****Thomson Power Systems** (a Regal Rexnord company) is a leading manufacturer of electrical products and systems with over 50 years of industry experience. We are seeking a talented **Engineering Manager** to lead and develop a multidisciplinary engineering team supporting custom-engineered switchgear, control panels, and electrical distribution products. Based in Langley, BC, this role is responsible for people leadership, technical oversight, and the execution of engineering projects aligned with business objectives, customer requirements, and manufacturing capabilities. The Engineering Manager will collaborate closely with Project Management, Quoting, R&D, Production, RBS, and Supply Chain to drive performance, technical excellence, and continuous improvement through the Regal Rexnord Business System (RBS). This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated individual looking to contribute to a fast-growing organization and build a long-term career.  

**Main Responsibilities**

- Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team of electrical and mechanical engineers and designers, providing coaching, mentorship, performance management, and career development.
- Own engineering execution for custom-engineered and standard products, ensuring delivery is on time, within scope, and meets quality standards.
- Provide technical oversight and decision-making authority for switchgears, control panels, and electrical distribution products.
- Ensure customer specifications, regulatory requirements, and applicable engineering standards are fully understood and incorporated into designs.
- Partner with the Plant Manager and cross-functional teams to align engineering priorities with business objectives and production capacity.
- Establish and maintain engineering best practices, standard work, design guidelines, and documentation processes to improve efficiency, quality, and scalability.
- Assist New Product Development (NPD) initiatives with technical reviews and support.
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on cost reduction, design standardization, manufacturability, and lead time reduction.
- Lead the resolution of complex technical, quality, and field issues through root cause analysis and corrective actions.
- Oversee development and maintenance of test plans, validation procedures, and design verification activities.
- Support customer engagements, including technical reviews, factory acceptance testing (FAT), and issue resolution.
- Manage departmental workload, priorities, and resource allocation to meet operational and strategic objectives.
- Ensure compliance with internal processes, safety requirements, and applicable engineering standards and codes.
- Define, track, and communicate key performance metrics to business leaders and cross-functional teams.
- Build organizational capability by fostering a high-performance culture grounded in Regal Rexnord values and employee engagement.

**Qualifications**

- Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering from an accredited institution.
- Professional engineering certification (P.Eng.), preferably in British Columbia.
- 10+ years of technical experience in switchgears and power distribution products.
- 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in engineering or comparable technical roles within a manufacturing or engineered-to-order environment.
- Recognized subject matter expert (SME) in switchgear products.
- In-depth knowledge of applicable switchgear standards, including UL 891, UL 1066, UL 1558, CSA C22.2, ANSI C37.20.2, UL 1008, ANSI/IEEE C37.04 & C37.06 and NEC/CEC.
- Familiar with CAD tools and engineering change management processes.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
- Working knowledge of ERP (e.g. SAP or equivalent).
- Legally authorized to work in Canada without company sponsorship.
- Ability and willingness to travel up to 10%.

**Skills**

- Strong organizational, planning, and problem-solving skills.
- Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary engineering teams.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously with result driven mindset.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with professional fluency in English.
- Strong cross-functional leadership capability, including managing direct reports and driving strategic growth initiatives within a highly matrixed organization.
- Customer-focused decision-making grounded in value creation and long-term partnerships.

**About Regal Rexnord**Regal Rexnord is a publicly held global industrial manufacturer with 30,000 associates around the world who help create a better tomorrow by providing sustainable solutions that power, transmit and control motion. The Company’s electric motors and air moving subsystems provide the power to create motion. A portfolio of highly engineered power transmission components and subsystems efficiently transmits motion to power industrial applications. The Company’s automation offering, comprised of controls, actuators, drives, and precision motors, controls motion in applications ranging from factory automation to precision control in surgical tools.  

The Company’s end markets benefit from meaningful secular demand tailwinds, and include factory automation, food & beverage, aerospace, medical, data center, warehouse, alternative energy, residential and commercial buildings, general industrial, construction, metals and mining, and agriculture.  

Regal Rexnord is comprised of three operating segments: Industrial Powertrain Solutions, Power Efficiency Solutions, and Automation & Motion Control. Regal Rexnord has offices and manufacturing, sales and service facilities worldwide. For more information, including a copy of our Sustainability Report, visit RegalRexnord.com.

In the absence of a signed Master Service Agreement or similar contract and approval from HR to submit resumes for a specific requisition, Regal Rexnord will not consider or approve payment to any third-parties for hires made.

We believe that data, harnessed properly, can spark powerful consumer insights, business transformation and marketing innovation.  

We are a full stack Google partner with a 14 year track record of delivering solutions to leading brands across multiple industries.  

As a Kepler Group company, Napkyn draws from Kepler's strategic, technology- and data-driven marketing expertise to provide world-class Google marketing support.  

**The Napkyn Team Is Guided By Kepler’s Values**

- Kepler prides itself on being a great place to work. In fact, we’re proud to share that AdAge just recognized Kepler as the #7 Best Place to Work”, validating our investment in our team and our clients.
- We're transparent with our employees. You'll hear updates on company financials, how we're performing against bonus goals, and how we're responding to challenges we face.
- We're growing. For you, that means unparalleled growth opportunities and a role in shaping the direction of the company.
- We're fun, authentic, empathetic, and ever-in-motion. You'll work with and learn from the smartest people in the industry and have a blast doing it.
- We're human. You'll have an option to join Employee Resource Groups, DEI initiatives, and altruism efforts to bring positive societal impact.

**About The Role**This role bridges engineering, analytics, and business—turning data into insights that drive business and marketing decisions. The **Senior Cloud Data Architect** works directly with clients to understand their challenges and designs practical cloud-based solutions in Google Cloud and similar private cloud environments. Combining hands-on data engineering, analytics modeling, and client problem solving, this role ensures data is usable, insights are trusted, and marketing and business teams—such as paid media, CRM/lifecycle, and growth teams—can make informed decisions with confidence around campaign performance, customer acquisition, and retention.  

The successful candidate will act as a trusted technical advisor, helping clients navigate complex data challenges while delivering practical, production-ready solutions.  

**Primary Responsibilities**

- Lead technical discovery sessions with clients to understand business challenges, define solution approaches, and recommend cloud data architectures that meet functional and strategic objectives.
- Integrate data from marketing platforms (e.g., paid media, analytics, CRM) and apply domain knowledge to frame business problems and deliver insights aligned with marketing performance objectives.
- Collaborate directly with clients to understand business objectives, technical requirements, and success criteria.
- Serve as a trusted technical advisor and partner to clients, guiding them through solution design decisions, implementation approaches, trade-offs and best practices and supporting long-term success.
- Navigate ambiguous and evolving requirements by structuring problems, validating assumptions, and aligning technical solutions to real business needs without relying on incomplete or incorrect inputs.
- Act as the conduit between client business, marketing and their technical teams to ensure alignment from technical problem definition through delivery.
- Develop data integration for customer private cloud environments, leveraging available tools in that platform, APIs, and scripting.
- Build, or consult on, infrastructure required for optimal extraction, transformation, and loading of data across diverse data sources.
- Assess existing customer pipelines and offer improvements for efficiency, security, scalability and data quality.
- Mentor and support team members through technical guidance and knowledge sharing to help elevate team capabilities and promote best practices.
- Develop reusable data models, pipelines, and dashboard templates that improve delivery consistency and accelerate future client engagements.
- Understand cloud infrastructure and operational requirements sufficiently to anticipate how architectural decisions impact reliability, performance, and business outcomes.

**Required Skills & Experience**

- Proficiency building ETL/ELT pipelines in private cloud environments (Google Cloud, AWS, Azure).
- Experience designing and implementing data solutions for marketing, advertising, or customer analytics use cases, including integration with Google Marketing Platform products and related marketing vendor APIs.
- Strong Computer Science (CS) fundamentals, problem-solving skills and software engineering skills.
- A strong ability to understand and organize data from various sources.
- Strong expertise in a programming language (preferably Python).
- Proficiency writing queries with SQL.
- Experience with Google Cloud, especially BigQuery.
- Experience building solutions via API integration.
- Knowledge of OAuth protocols for API authentication.
- Experience with quality assurance (QA) and devops processes.
- Strong understanding of security and privacy implications in data pipelines.
- Ability to identify and resolve performance and data quality in data pipelines.
- Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
- Experience mentoring technical colleagues or leading technical discussions.
- Ability to influence technical decision-making, facilitate solution discussions, and build consensus with client and internal stakeholders.
- Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Ability to prioritize projects and handle multiple tasks efficiently.
- A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Information Systems, or other quantitative fields, or comparable industry experience.

**Preferred Skills & Experience**

- Experience with a range of data warehousing and integration platforms and software, such as Snowflake, Databricks and dbt.
- Experience with a wide variety of APIs for marketing platforms & products.
- Experience with AI deployment in cloud environments, especially Gemini.
- Experience with Kotlin/JVM or JavaScript in addition to Python is an asset.
- Google Cloud Professional certifications, particularly the Data Engineer, Cloud Database Engineer or ML Engineer certifications, are an asset.

**Location:** Remote - based in Canada

We are committed to diversity of background, thought and experience, and we work to create an environment in which all our employees thrive by bringing their authentic self to work.
