La Maison Simons a été fondée en 1840 par John Simons à Québec. À l’origine une mercerie, l’entreprise familiale est aujourd’hui synonyme de mode accessible et inspirée. Tout est mis en œuvre pour cultiver la créativité et bâtir des relations de qualité avec la clientèle, le personnel et les partenaires. L’entreprise est soucieuse de l’environnement et des communautés où elle opère.  

Simons est reconnue comme une autorité mode avec son concept de magasinage original. Collections exclusives, marques émergentes locales et nationales ainsi que pièces de grands créateurs et créatrices internationaux sont offertes sous un même toit, à travers des univers distinctifs.  

La personne qui occupe ce poste joue un rôle clé dans la valorisation et l’exploitation des données de l’entreprise afin de soutenir la prise de décision et l’amélioration de la performance. Relevant de la Directrice, Directeur TI, Données, Intelligence d’Affaires et Intelligence Artificielle, elle contribue au développement des solutions analytiques, accompagne les partenaires d’affaires dans l’utilisation des données et participe à l’évolution des capacités d’intelligence d’affaires de Simons.  

**Principales Responsabilités**

- Analyser les données de l’entreprise afin d’identifier les tendances, les opportunités d’amélioration et les leviers de création de valeur.
- Collaborer avec les partenaires d’affaires pour comprendre leurs besoins d’information et recommander des solutions analytiques adaptées.
- Participer à la conception, au développement et à l’évolution des tableaux de bord, indicateurs de performance et rapports décisionnels.
- Veiller à la qualité, à la cohérence et à la fiabilité des données utilisées par les plateformes analytiques.
- Contribuer aux initiatives d’intelligence artificielle, d’automatisation et d’innovation basées sur les données.
- Accompagner les utilisateurs dans l’interprétation des données et promouvoir les meilleures pratiques en matière d’exploitation de l’information.

**Profil Recherché**

- Détenir un baccalauréat en intelligence d’affaires, en analytique, en statistiques, en informatique, en mathématiques ou dans un domaine connexe.
- Posséder de huit (8) à dix (10) années d’expérience en intelligence d’affaires, analytique ou exploitation des données.
- Détenir une expérience significative dans le développement de tableaux de bord, d’indicateurs de performance et de solutions décisionnelles.
- Posséder une excellente capacité à analyser des données complexes et à les transformer en recommandations favorisant la prise de décision.
- Avoir de l’expérience avec des plateformes d’intelligence d’affaires, des outils analytiques modernes et des initiatives de gouvernance des données.
- Démontrer d’excellentes habiletés de communication et de vulgarisation auprès des partenaires d’affaires.
- Être reconnu pour son esprit analytique, sa curiosité intellectuelle et son orientation vers la création de valeur.
- Être en mesure de s'exprimer en français et en anglais, à l'oral comme à l'écrit.

**Avantages**

- Service de télémédecine et programme d'aide aux membres du personnel et à leur famille.
- Régime d'assurance collective et REER.
- Jusqu'à 40 % de rabais sur vos achats chez Simons.
- Salle d'entraînement complète avec vestiaires et service de kinésiologie.
- Service de cafétéria proposant un menu varié et abordable.
- Et bien plus...

Chez Simons, les personnes sont au cœur de tout ce que nous entreprenons. Nous accordons une attention particulière au bien-être de nos employées et employés et de leur famille, en soulignant les moments importants qui marquent leur parcours, qu’il s’agisse d’anniversaires de service ou d’étapes significatives de leur vie.  

La créativité, l’esprit de communauté et le respect font partie intégrante de notre ADN. Nous offrons à chacune et à chacun la possibilité de bâtir une carrière à son image, que ce soit au sein de nos magasins, à notre siège social ou à notre Campus de Québec. Fiers de reconnaître la contribution de nos équipes, nous proposons des conditions de travail compétitives ainsi qu’une gamme d’avantages complète et évolutive. Nous favorisons également la flexibilité et un environnement de travail accueillant, inclusif et bienveillant, où tous peuvent s’épanouir pleinement.  

Saisissez l’occasion de joindre une équipe passionnée et de contribuer à une entreprise qui place les gens au cœur de ses priorités.

From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.  

**About The Role**Every enterprise adoption of dbt begins with a set of questions that have nothing to do with SQL. Can we prove who's logging in? Can we control what they touch? Can we run this inside our own network, in our own region, under our own compliance regime? You own the answer to all of it.  

As the **Senior Product Manager** for Enterprise and Deployments, you own the trust and access layer of the dbt platform — how people and organizations authenticate, what they're authorized to do, and where the platform actually runs. That spans the identity and auth primitives underneath the product (OAuth, account discovery), the enterprise security surface customers evaluate us on (SSO, SCIM, RBAC, PrivateLink), the first five minutes of every account (login, sign-up, invites, users, groups), and the deployment footprint itself, including expansion into new regions and cloud providers.  

This is foundational infrastructure work with an unusually short line to revenue. dbt is used by more than 100,000 open-source community members and tens of thousands of customers, and the constraint on the largest of them is rarely the product's capability — it's whether the trust layer clears their bar. When you get this right, you unlock new regions, new deployment models, and a class of customer we can't fully serve today. If you've watched a company like Auth0 turn deeply technical identity work into a product engineers actually love, this will feel familiar.  

You'll work across two engineering teams — IAM and Transport — and partner closely with security, infrastructure, compliance, and the field teams who live inside enterprise security reviews. dbt Labs recently merged with Fivetran to build the open data infrastructure layer that AI depends on, which means an established customer base and ARR momentum on one side and a genuinely new problem space on the other.  

In this role, you will:  

- Own the roadmap for identity, access, and deployment across the dbt platform — from the auth primitives other teams build on to the admin surfaces customers configure themselves.
- Make enterprise security a reason we win, not a hurdle we clear. SSO, SCIM, RBAC, and PrivateLink are table stakes for the customers we're chasing; your job is to get them past table stakes and make administration something buyers remark on.
- Lead the single-tenant to multi-tenant migration — a multi-quarter program moving existing enterprise customers onto a modern deployment model without a visible seam, including account domain and subdomain changes.
- Unlock new geographies and clouds. Decide where we deploy next and what has to be true — data residency, regional isolation, cloud provider parity — to get there.
- Own the front door. Login, sign-up, and account discovery decide whether a new user reaches value or bounces, and whether a large organization can onboard thousands of people without filing a ticket.
- Give admins real leverage over users, groups, invites, and permissions, so provisioning at enterprise scale is self-serve rather than a support motion.
- Be the product voice in enterprise security reviews. Work with the field, security, and compliance to turn recurring blockers into roadmap, and turn roadmap into things sales can sell.
- Partner with infrastructure and platform teams on the telemetry and observability needed to operate this layer with confidence — and to know when it's degrading before a customer tells you.

What success looks like:  

- Security and architecture review stops being the thing that stalls enterprise deals; the questions we used to escalate now have documented answers in the product.
- Sign-up and login conversion improve while auth-related support volume goes down.
- Enterprise admins provision, de-provision, and audit their users without involving us.
- Engineering leadership treats you as the person who sets direction, not the person who writes tickets.

You're a good fit if you have:  

- 5+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time on identity, access management, security, or infrastructure products.
- Direct experience with authentication and authorization — SSO, SCIM, OAuth/OIDC, RBAC, identity providers. You've shipped in this space and have opinions about where the standards help and where they get in the way.
- Experience with multi-tenant SaaS deployment models — tenancy, isolation, regional expansion, and the migration paths between them.
- A strong technical foundation that lets you work as a genuine peer to engineering, reason about architecture, and hold your own in a design review.
- Comfort in front of enterprise customers, particularly their security and platform teams, and a track record of turning what you hear there into prioritized product work.
- Excellent written communication — crisp specs, clear tradeoffs, and the ability to explain a security decision to a security team and to a salesperson in the same week.
- Comfort operating asynchronously on a distributed team.

We don't expect one person to be deep in every one of these. If you're strong in most of them and hungry about the rest, we want to talk.  

You'll have an edge if you have:  

- Worked at an identity provider (Okta, Auth0, Entra) or on identity, access, or deployment products at a hyperscaler — AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
- Shipped private networking capabilities: PrivateLink, VPC peering, or customer-managed network isolation.
- Worked inside compliance frameworks — SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, HIPAA, GDPR and data residency — as a product owner rather than an observer.
- Migrated a large existing customer base between deployment or tenancy models.
- Background in telemetry and observability for platform services.
- Hands-on experience with dbt, analytics engineering, or the modern data warehouse ecosystem (Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, Redshift).

The MDA Space team of more than 3,400 space experts in Canada, the US and the UK has the knowledge and know-how to turn an audacious customer vision into an achievable mission – bringing to bear a one-of-a-kind mix of experience, engineering excellence and wide-eyed wonder that’s been in our DNA since day one. Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy-grow-and-hold-for-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world.

The Role

We are hiring a Senior Business Analyst, AI & Data Science to serve as an embedded business partner to one of our internal functional teams. You will be assigned to a single functional vertical at hire: Finance, M&A, Business Development, Human Resources, Legal, or Operations. You will spend your days inside that team, learning their workflows, surfacing high-value AI and data science opportunities, and shipping work that makes them faster, sharper, and more effective.

You will report into our central AI & Data Science team and work day-to-day alongside the leaders and operators of your assigned vertical. Think of yourself as a translator and a builder: fluent in the function's metrics and mechanics, fluent in what modern AI and data science can do, and trusted by both sides to bridge the two.

This is a hybrid role that blends three jobs, all applied inside your assigned function:

- ****AI strategist:**** identify, prioritize, and build the business case for AI and data science use cases that move the function's KPIs.
- ****Data science translator:**** bridge functional stakeholders and technical AI and data resources. Scope models and tools, then interpret outputs in clear, decision-useful terms.
- ****Operations partner:**** help the function operationalize AI and data tools in their workflows, drive adoption, and measure real impact.

Quick Facts

**Team**

AI & Data Science, embedded as business partner to one functional vertical

**Vertical assignment**

Finance, M&A, Business Development, Human Resources, Legal, or Operations. Assigned at hire based on fit and team need.

**Reports to**

Head of AI & Data Science, with a dotted line to the functional leader

**Location**

Toronto, Ontario. Hybrid: typically 2 to 3 days per week in our Toronto office, with occasional travel to functional team offsites.

**Type**

Full-time

**Level**

Senior

**Compensation**

Competitive base of CAD $130,000 to $170,000 plus performance bonus and benefits. Final offer reflects experience and qualifications.

What You Will Do

- Embed inside your assigned function (Finance, M&A, Business Development, Human Resources, Legal, or Operations). Learn its data, systems, KPIs, and pain points well enough that the team treats you as one of their own.
- Identify and prioritize AI and data science opportunities that move the function's metrics. Sequence them by impact, effort, and risk.
- Build clear, ROI-driven business cases for each opportunity. Define success metrics, sensitivities, and what would make the work fail.
- Translate business problems into well-scoped requirements for our AI and data science engineers. Translate model and tool outputs back into decisions the function can act on.
- Partner with the functional leader on roadmap and prioritization. Help them say yes to the right work and no to the rest.
- Drive adoption of AI and data tools inside the function. Train end users, design new workflows, and measure usage and outcomes after launch.
- Define and track KPIs for every initiative you support, including model performance, adoption, time saved, decision quality, and dollar impact.
- Stay close to the AI and data science landscape, including LLMs, agentic systems, and modern analytics tooling. Bring a clear, well-reasoned point of view to the team.
- Share what works across the AI & Data Science group so other functional partners benefit from your patterns and pitfalls.

What This Looks Like By Function

Your day-to-day will depend on the function you join. A few illustrative examples:

- ****Finance:**** automate close and reporting tasks, build forecasting and scenario models, surface working capital and cost insights, build self-serve analytics for finance leadership, accelerate management reporting cycles.
- ****M&A:**** build sourcing and pipeline analytics, develop scoring models for inbound and outbound targets, structure and enrich the deal database, automate market mapping and competitive research, support deal teams with data-driven insights.
- ****Business Development:**** build lead scoring and prioritization models, analyze outbound campaign performance, automate research workflows, develop dashboards for pipeline health, surface signals that predict engagement and conversion.
- ****Human Resources:**** build workforce and attrition analytics, model hiring funnel performance and time-to-fill, benchmark compensation, surface engagement and sentiment insights, and automate repetitive HR operations.
- ****Legal:**** automate contract review and clause extraction with LLMs, surface risk flags across the contract portfolio, build matter and legal spend analytics, and speed up vendor and NDA workflows.
- ****Operations:**** analyze process throughput and cycle times, forecast capacity and demand, model vendor and supplier performance, automate ticket and queue triage, and build dashboards that keep operational KPIs visible.

Who You Are

- 6 to 10 years of experience as a business analyst, strategy consultant, FP&A or finance analyst, BD or M&A analyst, product manager, or data science partner. At least 3 of those years involved AI, ML, or data science work.
- A bachelor's degree in a quantitative, business, or technical field. A master's degree is a plus, not a requirement.
- Working knowledge of machine learning concepts, model evaluation, data quality, and the limits of AI. You do not need to train models. You do need to know what is possible, what is hard, and what is risky.
- Strong comfort with SQL and a working familiarity with Python or R for data exploration. Strong Excel and modern BI tools (Looker, Power BI, Tableau, or similar).
- Strong financial and business acumen. You can build a credible business case in a spreadsheet and explain it clearly in a one-pager.
- Excellent communication skills. You can explain a model to an executive and translate an executive's question into a well-scoped piece of analysis or model.
- Track record of being trusted by a non-technical functional team. People you have partnered with want to work with you again.
- Curiosity, judgment, and humility. You ask good questions, push back when needed, and stay genuinely interested in the work of the people you support.

Bonus Points

- Direct experience inside Finance, M&A, or Business Development. Bonus for software, SaaS, or vertical market software environments.
- Hands-on work with LLMs, retrieval systems, or agentic workflows applied to internal operations.
- Prior experience as an embedded analyst or business partner, rather than a member of a fully centralized analytics team.
- A track record of measuring AI or data science ROI in production, not just in pilots.

Why Banyan

- Real ownership of a function's AI agenda. You will not be a ticket-taker on a centralized data team.
- A long-term horizon. We do not optimize for the next quarter, so the work you ship can compound.
- A team that treats AI as a serious capability, not a buzzword. We have already built internal AI tooling we use every day.
- A culture of accountable autonomy. We trust you to do the work.
- Competitive compensation, benefits, and meaningful long-term upside.

How to Apply

Send your resume and a short note about a time you brought AI or data science into a functional team's workflow. Tell us the impact, what made it hard, and what you would do differently next time.

If you have a preference between Finance, M&A, Business Development, Human Resources, Legal, and Operations, let us know. We will assign the vertical based on fit and team need, and we want to hear how you think about it.

We look forward to hearing from you.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.  

Google utilizes AI tools to assist in assessing candidates in our hiring processes.  

**Minimum qualifications:**

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
- 10 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
- Experience with cloud developing, on-premise developing, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
- Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
- Experience in programming languages, debugging, systems design, prototyping, demos, or customer workshops.
- Ability to communicate in French fluently to support regional clients.

**Preferred qualifications:**

- Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: Infrastructure Modernization, Application Modernization, Data Management, Data Analytics, Cloud AI, Networking, Migrations, Security.
- Experience driving the entire business cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
- Experience building long-term technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
- Experience migrating applications and services to cloud platforms.
- Experience with security concepts (e.g., encryption, identity management, access control, attack vectors, pen testing).

**About The Job**The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.  

In this role, you will partner with technical sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand their business challenges. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs of concepts and demos, and use your expertise to design cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business challenges. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your strategic acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud.  

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.  

Canada: $194000 - $198000 (CAD) + 42.86% bonus target + equity + benefits  

**Responsibilities**Learn more about benefits at Google .  

- Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting targeted sales motions.
- Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through complex demos, pilots and in-depth workshops.
- Design cross-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers. Lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
- Facilitate the post-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
- Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration or implementation phases.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

Curinos empowers financial institutions to put customers at the center of every decision. Our AI-first platform transforms proprietary data, advanced analytics and deep financial services expertise into timely recommendations - delivered right where teams work. The result: confident decisions, stronger customer relationships, and lasting, profitable growth.

Curinos operates under a hybrid modality and has office locations in New York, Chicago, Boston, Toronto, and London. This role is open to hybrid/ remote candidates based in Canada.

**Job Description**

Curinos is looking for a DevOps Manager to lead our cloud migration, automation, and release engineering initiatives as we rapidly scale and mature our systems. This role combines hands-on technical expertise with people leadership, overseeing a team responsible for building and maintaining reliable, scalable, and secure systems in a cloud-based environment. A strong candidate will bring experience with AWS, experience leading collaborative engineering teams, and a practical orientation toward building scalable operational solutions and processes.

**Responsibilities**

- Lead, mentor, and grow a team of DevOps/Site Reliability engineers by setting clear expectations, defining measurable success metrics, and fostering a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, collaboration, and operational excellence
- Provide stable, secure, and reliable infrastructure across our production and non-production environments, ensuring high-availability, performance, and operational resilience while supporting engineering agility
- Own the design, implementation, and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines to support fast, reliable software delivery
- Architect and manage cloud infrastructure (primarily AWS), ensuring scalability, security, and cost-efficiency
- Drive infrastructure-as-code practices using tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation
- Identify possible efficiency gains through AI
- Establish and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to ensure high availability and rapid incident response
- Provide a strong leadership presence, establishing and coaching a growth mindset and culture that includes active mentorship and career progression
- Partner with engineering, security, and product teams to align infrastructure strategy with business goals
- Drive stakeholder engagement and change management for infrastructure initiatives, ensuring new capabilities are effectively communicated, aligned to business and engineering needs, and successfully adopted across the organization
- Manage on-call rotations, incident response processes, and post-mortem reviews
- Oversee capacity planning, disaster recovery, and business continuity strategies
- Evaluate and implement new tools, technologies, and best practices to improve system reliability and team efficiency
- Provide production support as part of a 24/7 on-call rotation

**Top Skills We Are Looking For**

- Hybrid Environments: Experience with multi-cloud or hybrid cloud environments
- AWS Cloud Infrastructure: AWS certification(s), such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer, or equivalent hands-on experience designing, operating, and improving AWS-based infrastructure
- Growth: Prior experience scaling infrastructure for a high-growth organization
- AI and Efficiency: Experience using AI tooling to improve team velocity, quality, or efficiency, such as Amazon Q, Copilot, Claude, or comparable tools
- Technical Leadership: Ability to mentor team members, share technical expertise, and help others develop confidence and capability in DevOps, SRE, and infrastructure engineering practices
- People Leadership: Experience managing teams with a mix of experience levels, creating an environment where team members understand expectations, are supported in their growth, and are empowered to deliver high-quality outcomes

**Salary Range: $**160,000- $175,000 CAD (plus bonus)

**Desired Skills & Expertise**

- At least 3 years of experience in a management role with direct reports within DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineering
- Hands-on experience with AWS services such as EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, Lambda, ECS/EKS, or comparable cloud services
- Proven experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, CircleCI)
- Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar)
- Solid understanding of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
- Experience with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch)
- Familiarity with scripting/automation languages (Python, Bash, or similar)
- Strong understanding of networking, security, and system administration fundamentals
- Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
- Demonstrated experience mentoring and improving the performance of other engineers

**Why work at Curinos?**

- Competitive benefits, including a range of Financial, Health and Lifestyle benefits to choose from
- Flexible working options, including home working, flexible hours and part time options, depending on the role requirements – please ask!
- Unlimited PTO policy, floating holidays, volunteering days and a day off for your birthday
- Learning and development tools to assist with your career development
- Work with industry leading Subject Matter Experts and specialist products
- Regular social events and networking opportunities
- Collaborative, supportive culture, including an active DE&I program
- Employee Assistance Program which provides expert third-party advice on well-being, relationships, legal and financial matters, as well as access to counselling services

We know that sometimes the 'perfect candidate' doesn't exist, and that people can be put off applying for a job if they don't meet all the requirements. If you're excited about working for us and have relevant skills or experience, please go ahead and apply. You could be just what we need!

If you need any adjustments to support your application, such as information in alternative formats, special requirements to access our buildings or adjusted interview formats please contact us at careers@curinos.com and we’ll do everything we can to help.

**Inclusivity at Curinos**

We believe strongly in the value of diversity and creating supportive, inclusive environments where our colleagues can succeed. As such, Curinos is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, or religious creed, mental or physical disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, military or veteran status, citizenship, or other protected characteristics.

**Are you ready to take your career to the next level? Your future starts here.**  

Join Egis, where your ambition meets unparalleled growth opportunities. As we continue to expand within Canada, we're looking for talented professionals like you to be a part of our innovative team. Imagine working alongside over 1,000 top-tier engineers, architects, and planners, all dedicated to shaping the future of infrastructure and development.   

At Egis, your skills and aspirations will find the perfect environment to thrive. Elevate your career with us and be a driving force in our exciting journey.

Our values showcase everything we believe in:

**A Responsible Company**- We care about people, and we care about our impact; acting responsibly wherever we work and whatever we do.  

**A People-First Company** - This is an environment of mutual respect where every team member matters, no matter who they are. 

**A Creative Company** - Creativity is in our DNA. This is the fuel that helps us tackle the major challenges of our time.  

**Job Description**

The CDE Facilitator will lead the implementation, configuration, and governance of Common Data Environments (CDEs) across the project lifecycle, ensuring seamless information flow between design, construction, and asset management teams. This role is responsible for enabling interoperability between platforms such as Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), ProjectWise, Aconex, and SharePoint through C#, Python, and API-driven integrations.

The position also supports data-driven decision-making through Power BI dashboards and performance analytics, while ensuring compliance with ISO 19650 and project information management requirements. The role plays a critical part in establishing scalable, efficient, and integrated digital delivery environments for complex infrastructure projects.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Configure, manage, and govern CDE platforms including Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), ProjectWise, Aconex, and SharePoint in alignment with project and client requirements.  

Develop and implement interoperability solutions using **C#, Python, and REST APIs** to enable seamless data exchange across platforms and systems.  

Design and automate workflows for document control, model exchange, approvals, transmittals, and version control across integrated CDE environments.  

Establish and enforce CDE standards, naming conventions, metadata structures, and information governance in compliance with **ISO 19650**.  

Lead **SharePoint architecture and setup** to support structured collaboration and integration with project CDEs.  

Develop automation tools and scripts to streamline file synchronization, metadata mapping, and cross-platform coordination.  

Build and maintain **Power BI dashboards** to monitor CDE performance, document workflows, model delivery, KPIs, and overall project health.  

Support bulk data uploads, migrations, and structured information exchange between legacy systems and project platforms.  

Collaborate with BIM, Digital Delivery, and IT teams to align CDE workflows with BIM Execution Plans (BEP) and project delivery requirements.  

Monitor system performance, data integrity, and user adoption, implementing continuous improvements to enhance efficiency and compliance.  

Identify and resolve interoperability challenges, ensuring reliable and scalable data exchange across all platforms.  

Provide training and technical support to project teams on CDE usage, workflows, and best practices.  

Support digital twin and asset information management initiatives through structured data capture and integration.

**Qualifications**

Degree or Diploma in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Management, or a related field.  

5–8 years of experience in CDE management, BIM digital delivery, or information management within major infrastructure projects.  

Strong proficiency in **C# programming** for developing integrations, automation tools, and interoperability solutions.  

Proficiency in **Python** for scripting, data processing, and workflow automation.  

Experience with **RESTful APIs and .NET framework** for system integration and cross-platform data exchange.  

Hands-on experience configuring and administering **Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC), ProjectWise, and Aconex**.  

Proven experience in **SharePoint setup, configuration, and integration** within project environments.  

Strong experience in **Power BI dashboard development**, including data modeling, visualization, and integration with BIM/CDE data sources.  

Solid understanding of **ISO 19650** and information management/CDE governance frameworks.  

Experience with metadata structuring, file naming conventions, and document control workflows.  

Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot interoperability and data exchange challenges.  

Effective communication skills with the ability to coordinate across BIM, IT, and project delivery teams.

**Nice to Have / Assets:**  
Working knowledge of **PowerShell** for automation and administrative scripting.  

Working knowledge of **SQL** for data querying, transformation, and reporting.  

Familiarity with **JavaScript** for advanced integrations or lightweight application development.  

Experience with **ETL processes** and data pipeline development across multiple systems.  

Exposure to **digital twin platforms** and asset information management systems.  

Experience working on **rail and transit infrastructure projects** or with large public-sector clients.  

Demonstrated interest in innovation, automation, and continuous improvement in digital delivery environments.

**Additional Information**

*We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.*

*This role is eligible for a referral bonus in line with the Referral Program. If you have been referred, please provide the name of the employee who has referred you at the time of your application.*

*At Egis, we embrace innovation to tackle challenges and utilize AI in our recruitment process under stringent ethics and compliance policies and in alignment with our values of being a Responsible Company, a People First Company and a Creative Company. Committed to diversity, growth and collaboration, we may leverage AI to support the recruitment process.*

*Egis Canada is an equal opportunities employer offering a competitive salary and benefits to those with the skills suited to the needs of our clients. The salary range advertised may exceed the range based on several factors, including relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, performance, and business or organizational needs.*

**Position Summary:**

Primaris REIT is currently seeking a strategic and results-driven Vice President, Development & Construction to join our team at our Toronto Head Office. This leadership role oversees development, redevelopment and major construction projects across a portfolio of enclosed shopping centres. The successful candidate will combine development and construction expertise with strong financial judgment and the ability to deliver projects on time and on budget within a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

**Vacancy Status:** New Position

**Role:**

As the Vice President, Development & Construction, you will be accountable for moving projects from concept and pre-development through internal approvals, design, tendering, construction, and handover to Property Operations. You will also:

**Development and Project Execution**

- Lead development, redevelopment and major capital projects from initial concept through completion.
- Oversee feasibility, due diligence, planning, design, budgeting, scheduling and municipal approvals.
- Advance ideas effectively through internal review and approval channels.
- Establish project scope, business rationale, delivery strategy, budget, schedule and key risks.
- Manage projects through design, tendering, construction, commissioning and operational handover.
- Coordinate construction within active shopping centres while minimizing disruption to tenants, customers and property operations.
- Ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, on budget and to approved quality standards.

**Financial and Executive Leadership**

- Prepare and oversee project budgets, forecasts, cash flows, contingencies and financial analyses.
- Evaluate project economics and clearly articulate how investments protect or create value.
- Translate complex financial and technical information into a compelling business narrative.
- Present recommendations, options, trade-offs and risks confidently to the Head of Development & Construction and other senior leadership.
- Provide clear, concise reporting and early identification of emerging issues.
- Manage upward effectively while maintaining accountability for project outcomes.

**Design, Procurement, and Construction**

- Lead architects, engineers, planners, cost consultants, general contractors and other project partners.
- Read, interpret and challenge architectural, engineering and construction drawings and specifications.
- Evaluate design for completeness, constructability, cost, operational suitability and alignment with project objectives.
- Develop procurement strategies and oversee competitive tendering and contractor selection.
- Negotiate commercial terms and maintain disciplined contract and change-order management.
- Oversee schedules, critical paths, progress claims, deficiencies, commissioning and closeout.
- Anticipate approval risks and establish practical strategies to maintain project momentum.
- Build and maintain a strong national network of general contractors, consultants, trades and subcontractors.

**Organizational and Team Leadership**

- Partner with Leasing, Operations, Asset Management, Finance, Legal and Property Management.
- Build alignment across internal stakeholders and resolve competing priorities.
- Lead, coach and develop the Development & Construction team.
- Establish consistent project governance, reporting, cost controls and approval practices.
- Support acquisition due diligence, capital planning and portfolio strategy.
- Represent the REIT professionally with tenants, municipalities, contractors and other external stakeholders.

Other reasonable job duties and/or projects may be assigned.

**Requirements:**

To excel in this role, we are looking for a motivated and adaptable professional who communicates openly, takes initiative, embraces change, and is committed to delivering exceptional results. If this opportunity sounds interesting to you, you are likely to possess the following attributes:

- University degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Real Estate, Business, or a related field.
- Relevant professional designation (e.g., P.Eng., OAA, PMP) is an asset.
- Valid driver's license and ability to travel across Canada.
- 15+ years of experience in commercial real estate development and construction, including 7+ years in a leadership role.
- Demonstrated expertise in both development and construction, with experience leading multi-project, multi-market portfolios.
- Proven track record managing significant capital programs and complex development and construction projects.
- Bilingual (French/English) full professional fluency strongly preferred.
- Comprehensive knowledge of the development and construction lifecycle, including planning, design, procurement, contract administration, and project delivery.
- Strong financial acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, project evaluation, and value creation.
- Ability to interpret construction and design documentation and effectively manage project risks, costs, and schedules.
- Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
- Strong leadership, commercial judgment, and decision-making abilities.
- Proven ability to collaborate across functions and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Join us and play a key role in shaping the future of our portfolio through the successful delivery of development, redevelopment and major construction projects across Canada. We are seeking a strategic, results-driven leader with strong financial acumen, exceptional stakeholder management skills, and a proven ability to lead complex projects and teams while delivering value, managing risk, and achieving business objectives.

**AI Use & Accommodation:**

To manage the large volume of applications, AI may be used in the recruitment process. If your qualifications align with the requirements of this role, you may be contacted for next steps.

Primaris REIT is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing fair recruitment and employment practices to all employees and applicants. If you require accommodation for this role, please contact careers@primarisreit.com.

**Competencies:**

- Communicate clearly, concisely, professionally and convey active listening and openness.
- Build positive relationships and demonstrate commitment, effort and a "take charge" attitude.
- Produce accurate work with attention to detail and consistently meet deadlines.
- Take ownership for actions, accept constructive criticism and make the necessary changes to behaviour.
- Overcome obstacles to get the job done, identify problems and recommend solutions.
- See change positively and adapt quickly to change in work requirements.

**Values:**

- Respect: Value diverse perspectives, experiences and talents; treat others the way you would want to be treated
- Empowerment: Use the means provided to carry out responsibilities to the best of your ability and to implement creative ideas
- Integrity: Do the right thing, deliver on commitments and admit mistakes
- Teamwork: Work together as one team toward common goals
- Accountability: Hold yourself and others accountable for decisions and results

**Next Steps:**

If you are ready to embark on a rewarding career in the exciting world of real estate, we would love to hear from you!

We appreciate all applications and will only contact those selected for an interview.

Join our team as a **Vice President, Design & Construction** and contribute to creating a positive and welcoming shopping experience.

Primaris is committed to accessibility for persons with disabilities in the course of employment, including in recruitment and hiring. If, as a result of a disability, you require accommodation in order to apply for this role and/or participate in the recruitment process, please contact

careers@primarisreit.com.

Primaris REIT is Canada’s leading enclosed shopping centre-focused real estate investment trust. We own and operate a portfolio of 15.2 million square feet of dominant enclosed shopping centres valued at approximately $5.2 billion at Primaris’ share. Our vision is to champion and elevate retail for Canadians by creating an exceptional experience for our customers while maintaining a strong presence in the industry.

**Description Du Poste**Ce poste est un rôle de gestionnaire de projets spécialisé en sécurité physique, responsable de la planification, de la coordination et de la livraison de projets liés à la protection des personnes, des sites et des actifs de l’organisation. **Vos responsabilités :**

- Analyser les besoins des clients et élaborer les plans de conception des projets

- Ajuster les plans en fonction des changements en cours de projet
- Préparer les rapports d’avancement et de performance des projets
- Réaliser des audits de sécurité (avant/après projet ou au besoin)

- Minimum 3 ans d’expérience en gestion de projets ou domaine connexe
- Excellente capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités et livrer dans les délais
- Leadership mobilisateur et forte capacité d’influence
- Excellentes compétences en communication (oral et écrit), bilingue français/anglais
- Solide esprit d’équipe et aptitude à collaborer avec divers intervenants
- Orientation résultats et amélioration continue
- Maîtrise de la suite Microsoft Office
- Autonomie, sens de l’initiative et fortes capacités organisationnelles
- Expérience en gestion budgétaire et prévisions (analyse des tendances un atout)

- Salaire compétitif + autres avantages;
- Programme d'assurance collective et de REER;
- Événements à l'échelle de l'entreprise tout au long de l'année (barbecue, fête de Noël, etc.);

- Deux cafétérias sur place (programme de repas subventionnés disponible);
- Environnement de travail dynamique et gratifiant - travaillez sur des projets à fort impact et significatifs tout en vous amusant !

At ExpensePoint, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous growth, where team members are empowered to make an impact. We’re looking for a self-motivated, service-driven leader with exceptional communication and analytical skills who thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced SaaS environment.

Opportunities to grow into Sales or Customer Success.

This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance. We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture. As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.  

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work.  

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.  

**How does this role contribute to our collective success**?  

The Insights Delivery Lead is responsible for leading the delivery, evolution and operational excellence of AXIS' Insights capability.  

This role leads a team of Insights and Visualization Developers responsible for delivering and maintaining reporting, dashboards, self-service analytics solutions and business intelligence products across the organization. As AXIS continues its data and AI transformation journey, the role will also be responsible for evolving the team's capabilities beyond traditional reporting into modern Power Platform development, AI-enabled experiences and Microsoft Copilot Studio agent development.  

**The role balances two equally important objectives:**Ensuring the stability, quality and effectiveness of existing reporting and insights capabilities.  

Leading the modernization of the function to support future business needs, including AI-powered insights, automation, digital assistants and next-generation analytics experiences.  

Working in close partnership with Insights & Analytics Leads, Data Product teams, Data Engineering, AI teams and business stakeholders, the Insights Delivery Lead will ensure delivery remains aligned to strategic priorities while maintaining high standards of governance, quality, usability and operational performance.  

This is a leadership role requiring strong delivery expertise, people leadership and a passion for continuous learning and innovation.  

**What will you do in this role?**Lead the Insights Delivery Function  

- Lead and develop a high-performing team of Insights and Visualization Developers.
- Create a culture focused on value, innovation, accountability and continuous improvement.
- Manage delivery capacity, resource allocation and prioritization across competing business demands.
- Develop talent, succession plans and career pathways within the Insights team.
- Foster collaboration across the broader Data & Analytics organization.

Deliver Business-Aligned Insights Solutions  

- Partner closely with Insights & Analytics Leads to deliver against business priorities and strategic objectives.
- Translate business requirements into high-quality reporting, dashboards, performance metrics and analytical solutions.
- Ensure delivery teams remain focused on solving business problems rather than simply producing reports.

Evolve the Capability for the Future  

- Lead the transformation of the Insights team from traditional BI delivery towards a broader analytics and digital solutions capability.
- Drive adoption of Power Platform technologies including Power Apps, Power Automate and emerging low-code solutions.
- Develop organizational capability in Microsoft Copilot Studio and AI-enabled agent development.
- Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation and self-service capabilities to improve business outcomes.
- Maintain awareness of emerging technologies and determine how they can create value for AXIS.

Balance Run and Change Responsibilities  

- Ensure existing reporting, dashboards and insights products remain reliable, accurate and supported.
- Lead continuous improvement of current solutions while delivering future-focused capabilities.
- Ensure business-critical insights remain highly available and fit for purpose.

Drive Delivery Excellence  

- Establish and embed agile delivery practices across the Insights team.
- Improve delivery predictability, transparency and stakeholder engagement.
- Remove barriers to delivery and support effective decision making.
- Drive continuous improvement through retrospectives, lessons learned and performance measurement.

Champion Governance, Quality and Standards  

- Establish and maintain high standards for design, development and deployment.
- Drive consistency, reuse and standardization across the Insights estate.
- Partner with Data Governance, Quality and Architecture teams to ensure solutions are appropriately controlled and managed.

Support D&A Transformation  

- Act as a key contributor to the broader Data & Analytics transformation agenda.
- Ensure Insights delivery capabilities evolve in line with the target operating model.
- Work closely with D&A leadership to maintain focus on long-term strategic objectives.

**Success Measures**Success in this role will be measured through:  

Delivery Performance  

- Consistent delivery of high-quality insights solutions aligned to business priorities.
- Improved delivery predictability, stakeholder satisfaction and adoption.

Operational Excellence  

- High availability and reliability of reporting and insights services.
- Reduction in technical debt and support overhead.

Capability Evolution  

- Expansion of team capabilities into Power Platform development and Copilot Studio solutions.
- Increased use of automation and AI-enabled experiences across the organization.

Team Development  

- Strong employee engagement, retention and capability growth.
- Development of a modern, adaptable and future-ready Insights function.

Transformation Outcomes  

- Meaningful contribution to D&A transformation objectives.
- Delivery of modern capabilities that improve business decision-making and operational effectiveness.

**About you:**We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table, so while there are some qualifications and experiences, we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge might lend itself to fulfilling this role and help us achieve our goals.  

**What you need to have:****Experience**

- Significant experience leading business intelligence, reporting, visualization or analytics delivery teams.
- Proven experience managing large and complex delivery portfolios.
- Demonstrated success leading teams through organizational, technology and operating model change.
- Experience delivering solutions using Microsoft Power BI and modern data platforms.
- Experience working within agile delivery environments.
- Experience balancing operational support responsibilities alongside strategic transformation initiatives.

Technical Knowledge  

- Deep expertise in Power BI and enterprise reporting environments.
- Strong understanding of data visualization principles and user-centered design.
- Knowledge of Power Platform technologies including Power Apps and Power Automate.
- Understanding of Microsoft Copilot Studio and emerging AI-enabled business solutions.
- Familiarity with analytics, machine learning and data product concepts.
- Understanding of modern data architectures and cloud-based analytics platforms.

Leadership Capabilities  

- Exceptional people leadership and coaching skills.
- Ability to lead confidently through ambiguity and change.
- Strong strategic thinking combined with delivery execution focus.
- Ability to build trusted partnerships across business and technical teams.
- Passion for continuous learning and technology innovation.
- Ability to maintain long-term strategic focus while managing day-to-day delivery pressures.

**Role Factors:**Be in the office 3 days per week  

**What we offer:**For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $175,000 - $200,000 USD (New York, NY), $110,000 - $130,000 CAD (Halifax, Nova Scotia) Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location.   

In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.    

Where this role is based in the United States of America, this role is Exempt for FLSA purposes.

**Title: Founding Service Operations and Member Experience Lead**

**About Village**

Village is an AI-powered household concierge for families with young children. We manage the invisible work of running a family, the research, planning, booking, and coordination that falls on parents, so they can focus on what matters most.

An AI assistant learns each household's rhythm and anticipates upcoming needs; human assistants handle what we believe requires the magic of human touch: the phone calls, the judgment calls, the nuance, while working alongside the agents to optimize the flow of the household.

Village was founded in Toronto by a physician and mother of three who built the service she needed. The company is bootstrapped and building towards launch. This is a critical role to getting the product to market with ambitious goals to onboard paying households by January 2027.

**Our Values**

- **Act like an owner.** We prioritize commitment, initiative, and follow-through with a stake in the outcome. We take ownership of problems instead of waiting for someone else to solve them, and we're willing to move between leading the work and getting hands-on to get it done, while analysing the risk and setting frameworks as we go to not see that friction point twice in our operating rhythm.
- **AI and humans alike, our toolkit.** Not everyone building is going to be a machine learning expert; but you should be comfortable working with AI tools daily, and if you are an AI expert you need to be comfortable working with your human counterparts.
- **We adapt and we figure it out.** Priorities change, experiments don't always work, and sometimes the job that needs doing won't fit neatly into anyone's job description. We stay curious, learn quickly, and adjust when new information changes the plan. We don't expect you to have seen every challenge before. We care that you ask good questions, use the resources around you, learn from setbacks, and keep moving toward a solution.

**The Role**

This is an exciting opportunity to build a mission-critical service for families from the ground up.

You will work directly with the founder to shape the service: developing the playbooks and quality standards the team works from as we scale to achieve our goal of 100 paying households by June 2027. This includes:

We are currently in the early production stages of our first title, *Zero State Agent*, and looking for a strategic addition to our Management Team. At Fortress Games, our vision is for players to find fun through unique and meaningful play, driven by memorable moments and unforgettable experiences.

Set in the near-future of the vast and diverse wilderness of Canada, against a backdrop of espionage and covert operations, Zero State Agent brings tactical stealth gameplay to open-world survival. Launching on PC, players will explore, craft, build, infiltrate and survive as they discover the truth behind a new global threat and the forces that brought them there.

●       A strong desire to be an early member of a small team with big ideas!

Unit8 is dedicated to driving AI adoption in non-digital industries, accelerating their digital transformation. We invest in projects that matter, including pro-bono initiatives and "engineering for good" causes.

**Are You the team member we are looking for?**

Following our remarkable growth in Europe and our recent expansion into the US market in early 2026, Unit8 is now taking its next strategic step in North America. We are seeking an entrepreneurially minded **Senior Data & AI Consultant/Consulting Lead** to establish our Canadian presence. You will be part of the Unit8 Data & AI Consulting Practice, driving the whole lifecycle from business development to project delivery and client relationship building. You will become a core team member and take responsibility for scaling up the consulting practice within a fast-growing professional services provider in Data & AI.

**What You'll Do**Your role can evolve and will depend on our clients' and internal challenges.

In general, you will:

- Work closely with the head of our Data & AI Consulting practice as part of a small, high-performing team
- Identify the use cases — across analytics, generative, and agentic AI — that actually create business value for our clients from strategy to implementation
- Guide clients on their journey to becoming truly data- and AI-driven, by assessing their data, analytics and AI maturity, spotting the use cases that deliver value across analytics, generative and agentic AI, and shaping a pragmatic roadmap to get there
- Team up with our data engineers, data scientists, AI engineers and solution architects to turn those use cases into impactful solutions, from modern data platforms and analytics products to machine learning and AI applications
- Shape the critical enablers that make data and AI work at scale, such as data & AI governance, LLMOps and MLOps, responsible, compliant AI, and the operating models behind data and AI centers of excellence
- Contribute to our business development in preparing and participating in industry conferences, workshops and client conversations
- Support the creation of white papers and industry thought leadership on data science & AI-related topics

**Requirements**

**You are**

- Equipped with **5-10 years of work experience in a leading management consultancy at the intersection of business & technology or an equivalent experience in a corporate environment**
- Backed with a track record of advising clients on data and AI (e.g. Agentic AI, GenAI, data & AI platforms) and seeing those engagements through to real outcomes and solutions
- Able to walk into ambiguity and make the judgement to quickly find the relevant things that matter to clients, either during an ongoing project or business development activities
- **Talented in building lasting relationships** with clients and team members
- Holding a Bachelor's or Master's degree in IT/computer science, engineering, business, mathematics, or natural sciences
- **Fluent in English, French is a plus**

**Benefits**

**What We Offer**

At Unit8, we don't just turn data into value - we empower the people who make it possible. If you are looking for a place where you can take ownership, your next chapter starts here.

- Groundbreaking Opportunity & Footprint. As one of our first Canadian hires, you will play a pivotal role in establishing Unit8's presence in this emerging market. You get to shape how the practice operates, which clients we target, and what we are known for in Canada
- Pioneering Autonomy. We offer the freedom and entrepreneurial ownership to drive our growth strategy. You will have the autonomy to decide how we deliver maximum value in this new geography
- High-Stakes Work. You will work on critical projects that transform how major industries operate
- A "Builder" Culture. We are not a slide-deck consultancy. We build things that work. Our consultants work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers and data scientists who ship production systems. You'll close the loop between strategy and delivery, not hand it off
- Shared Success (Profit Share). We win together, and we share the rewards together. Beyond a competitive base salary, we offer a transparent profit-share model. When Unit8 thrives, you directly benefit from the fruits of our collective impact

**Please submit your application materials exclusively in English.**

*Unit8 is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and respected. We believe that diversity drives innovation and enhances our ability to serve our clients effectively. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. We are dedicated to fostering an environment where everyone can thrive and contribute to our mission.*

We look forward to hearing from you!

If you are committed to public service, enjoy collaborating with others, share our values and have a desire to learn and grow, join The City of Calgary. City employees deliver the services, run the programs and operate the facilities which make a difference in our community. We support work-life balance, promote physical and psychological safety, and offer competitive wages, pensions, and benefits. Together we make Calgary a great place to make a living, a great place to make a life.

The City is committed to fostering a respectful, inclusive and equitable workplace which is representative of the community we serve. We welcome those who have demonstrated a commitment to upholding the values of equity, diversity, inclusion, anti-racism and reconciliation. Applications are encouraged from members of groups that are historically disadvantaged and underrepresented. Accommodations are available during the hiring process, upon request.

As a Data Strategist utilizing the Architecture of Integrated Information Systems (ARIS) software, you will lead the development and governance of Water Services' data and information management, supporting how the utility is interconnected through business processes, information artifacts, systems, reporting, and key performance indicators (KPIs).

This role is responsible for ensuring data housed in ARIS platform operates as a trusted, utility-wide repository for process models, reporting inventory, and related business information. You will work across multiple business areas to support consistent modeling practices, improve how information is structured and maintained, and enable better decision-making across the utility. Primary duties include:

- Lead the governance of the ARIS platform, including system configuration, structure, access, standards, and ongoing maintenance to ensure it functions as a reliable, Utility-wide repository.
- Improve consistency and quality of model content across the Utility by establishing and enforce modeling and governance standards. Developing reports and monitor and improve the quality and completeness of ARIS content, while identifying opportunities to enhance governance, tools, and processes and contributing to broader alignment and best practices.
- Provide guidance, training, and support the use of the ARIS repository, building organizational capability and driving adoption of consistent modeling and documentation practices.
- Define how models are created, reviewed, approved, published, archived, and updated. Ensure ARIS content remains current as processes, systems, regulations, or organizational structures change.
- Support for transformation initiatives, ARIS content across all use cases, including business process models, reporting inventory, and KPI alignment, ensuring information is structured, connected, and supports both operational and strategic decision-making.

**Qualifications**

- A degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Business, or a related field and at least 5 years of related experience.
- Experience working with enterprise tools supporting process modeling, reporting, or data management in a complex organization.
- Experience with ARIS or similar platforms is considered an asset.
- Strong understanding of governance practices related to business processes, reporting, or data management.
- Strong communication, problem-solving, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to work across business and technical teams.

**Pre-employment Requirements**

- Successful applicants must provide proof of qualifications.

**Workstyle**

- This position may be eligible to work from home for at least part of the time as one of several flexible work options available to City employees. These arrangements depend on the operational requirements of the role, employee suitability, and are subject to change based on operational needs and corporate direction.

Hydro One is proud to be the largest electricity transmission and distribution provider in Ontario, serving nearly 1.5 million customers. We have a long history in the industry with our roots dating back over 110 years to 1906. Since then, we have worked to grow and evolve to meet the changing needs of our customers and communities across Ontario. Today, we’re focused on providing exceptional customer service and ensuring we are building safe communities where we live, work and play.  

It’s an exciting time to join the team at Hydro One!  

**Job Function**

- Work under the Section Manager, implement engineering goals/objectives/strategies by providing effective team leadership and direction in establishing/maintaining an effective design resource capacity management, project management and outsourcing management service.
- Plan, organize, schedule and coordinate work and assign tasks providing instruction, as required to ensure that utilization of available Engineering resource is maximized, engineering design is properly coordinated so that deliverables are completed on time and on schedule.
- Manage the execution of consulting service contracts.
- Develop, obtain approval for and maintain engineering policies, standards, templates and processes.
- Report project status and resource capacity.
- Support and participate in decision making to enhance productivity of the Division.
- Prepare and monitor the budget of Project Engineering.

**Job Description**

- Manage the work of a team of project engineers, resource planners and contract service supporting staff in the delivery of resource capacity management, project management and outsourcing management services to enable Engineering to deliver project design packages according to project schedules and within approved budgets. Organize, plan, schedule, direct and coordinate work, assign tasks and monitor the progress of work to conform to schedules.
- Evaluate the effectiveness of the section's planning, project coordination and contract management capability through various means (capability assessments, quality control, etc.) and recommend changes to enhance performance. Interview and select candidates for staff positions. Assess the performance of staff and conduct performance appraisal interviews as required. Initiate recommendations on hiring, firing, transfer and promotion of staff. etc.
- Recruit, develop and maintain staff with the necessary type and quality of skills to deliver required project engineering service levels in the context of E&CS and Hydro One Networks' strategies, plans and objectives.
- Assume leadership roles in the management and development of skills training programs required to enhance staff capability.
- Perform day-to-day supervision, work assignment, monitoring and quality assurance of staff supervised. Be responsible for the work of staff assigned to specific projects or sub-projects, assigning and checking their work and giving guidance and direction as necessary, in a working environment which has the philosophy and goals of continuous quality improvement.
- Lead the development and implementation of business planning processes, project management processes, consulting services contract execution and work flow designs for Project Engineering to enhance efficiency and productivity of Engineering Division.
- Receive awards for project execution, engineering studies and standard development from internal and external customers and assign project engineers to manage the assigned work. Establish multi discipline teams for complex projects. Work in collaboration with the project manager, review the required work scope and communicate engineering requirements to the design team and to the appropriate staff in other departments.
- Supervise project engineers to ensure members of the production engineering team understand each one’s roles, accountabilities, knows the communication channels of the assigned project, design is properly coordinated by the production engineering team, a coherent production plan is established, risks are pro-actively identified and appropriately mitigated, project scope changes are managed according to established processes, procurement of services and goods follows company policies. Ensure engineering designs are delivered in accordance with agreed project schedules and within the given budget.
- Monitor work status of each project under production, provide analysis of progress and issues and provide feedback to the Engineering Managers, project managers and others.
- Monitor utilization of internal design resources and external consulting services. Evaluate resource supply and demand trends, consulting firm capability and supply situation of the market. Participate in resource planning and forecasting engineering resource requirements. Recommend actions to address production capacity expansion to meet the business plan of the company.
- Keep abreast of developments in various fields of engineering disciplines, business environment of the energy market in Ontario and applicable regulatory legislations, policies, guide lines.
- Provide ways and means to improve efficiency and economics of systems. Review technical publications and other literature. Communicate with counterparts in other utilities to exchange views and ideas to improve response time and costs of engineering design.
- Prepare and monitor short and long term budgets.
- Conduct special studies and analysis.
- Contribute in the development and documentation of Engineering & Construction Services engineering processes, systems and practices, including new concepts, working culture (people acceptance), philosophy, operating and maintenance of standards and engineering policy in the dynamically changing field of utility engineering.

At Hydro One we understand that the success and strength of our business rests with our people. When we develop their skills, we are investing in both their success and ours. **À propos du poste**Nous recherchons un(e) **Coordonnateur(trice) de projet senior - Équipe Support** afin de soutenir une équipe responsable de la gouvernance des processus opérationnels et de la **gestion des services TI (ITSM)**.  

Dans un contexte de transformation organisationnelle, la personne accompagnera plusieurs équipes dans la mise en place et l’optimisation des **processus d’astreinte, de support en production et de gestion des incidents**. Une partie de ces processus sera progressivement intégrée à **ServiceNow** afin d’améliorer l’efficacité opérationnelle et la traçabilité.  

Le rôle combine **coordination de projets TI, coordination d’équipes de support applicatif/opérationnel, ITSM, gestion des astreintes et leadership opérationnel**. La personne devra notamment être capable de débloquer rapidement les équipes confrontées à des enjeux en production et de coordonner les différentes parties prenantes afin d’identifier des solutions.  

Le mandat comporte également une composante administrative et financière incluant la **gestion des budgets d’équipe, l’approbation des feuilles de temps ainsi que la gestion des achats et bons de commande**.  

**Exigences et compétences**Exigences principales  

- Minimum de 7 à 10 années d’expérience dans des rôles similaires en coordination de projets TI et/ou coordination d’équipes de support.
- Expérience significative dans la coordination ou la gestion d’une équipe de support applicatif ou opérationnel en production.
- Expérience avec les processus de support 24/7 et de gestion des astreintes.
- Bonne compréhension des processus ITSM.
- Expérience en gestion des incidents, particulièrement dans des environnements de production.
- Expérience concrète en mode projet.
- Expérience dans des projets d’opérationnalisation ou de soutien de systèmes critiques.
- Expérience avec ServiceNow.
- Expérience en accompagnement du changement.
- Expérience en amélioration continue des processus opérationnels.
- Capacité à coordonner plusieurs équipes et intervenants.
- Leadership permettant de débloquer les équipes lors d’enjeux opérationnels ou de situations critiques.
- Expérience dans le suivi des échéanciers, risques, enjeux et dépendances.
- Capacité à faciliter et animer des ateliers et rencontres de coordination.
- Capacité à gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement opérationnel complexe.
- Excellentes capacités de communication et de collaboration.

Atouts importants  

- Expérience comme Scrum Master.
- Expérience comme Coach Agile.
- Expérience dans des environnements Agile.
- Expérience dans un environnement SAFe.

**Objectifs et livrables**

- Coordonner les initiatives et activités de l’équipe de support.
- Accompagner les équipes dans la mise en place et l’optimisation des processus d’astreinte.
- Améliorer les processus de gestion des incidents et des opérations TI.
- Soutenir l’évolution et l’intégration des processus opérationnels dans ServiceNow.
- Améliorer l’efficacité opérationnelle et la traçabilité des interventions.
- Assurer une coordination efficace des équipes lors d’incidents ou de situations critiques.
- Favoriser l’adoption des nouvelles pratiques, processus et outils.
- Identifier et éliminer les obstacles pouvant affecter les équipes de support.
- Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des pratiques ITSM.
- Assurer le suivi administratif et financier des activités de l’équipe.

**Responsabilités principales**

- Planifier, coordonner et assurer le suivi des initiatives de l’équipe.
- Coordonner les équipes de support applicatif et opérationnel.
- Accompagner les équipes dans l’implantation et l’amélioration des processus d’astreinte.
- Agir comme leader afin de débloquer les équipes confrontées à des enjeux opérationnels, organisationnels ou techniques.
- Coordonner les différents intervenants impliqués dans les activités ITSM.
- Assurer le suivi des échéanciers, risques, dépendances et enjeux.
- Faciliter les ateliers de travail et rencontres de coordination.
- Coordonner les interventions lors de situations critiques.
- Soutenir les équipes dans l’identification et la mise en œuvre de solutions.
- Contribuer à l’amélioration des processus de gestion des incidents et des opérations.
- Collaborer à l’intégration et à l’optimisation des processus dans ServiceNow.
- Accompagner les équipes dans l’adoption des nouvelles pratiques et processus.
- Identifier de façon proactive les problématiques susceptibles d’affecter la prestation des services.

- Effectuer le suivi financier des différentes initiatives.
