The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. - 5+ years of design/implementation/operations/consulting with distributed applications experience

Reporting to the Program Manager, Hope & Healing at CancerCare Manitoba (CCMB), the Clinical Services Leader, Nutrition Services oversees daily services and provides guidance and support to the dietitian team to ensure safe and responsive care for patients living with cancer. This position works in collaboration with all members of the multi-disciplinary cancer care team and uses a person-centred model of care to guide delivery of outpatient clinical nutritional services. This role is responsible for nutrition services planning and development, patient information and education resources, service standards, guidelines, promotion, reporting and evaluation, contributes to oncology nutritional research to foster development and improvement in oncology nutrition.  

The Clinical Services Leader, Nutrition Services works in collaboration with CCMB programs, Community Cancer Programs, Health Regions and external partners to ensure a multi-disciplinary and comprehensive approach to nutritional care. The Services Leader will establish and support a provincial oncology nutrition network to facilitate a community of practice for dietitians offering services to cancer patients in Manitoba. The Services Leader works to create a welcoming, equitable, and culturally safe care environment at CancerCare Manitoba.

- Ability to work ethically, with integrity and a high level of confidentiality, in accordance with professional standards, legislation and organizational policies.

- Proficient with Microsoft Office programs as well as electronic patient charting software.

- Excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive attitude towards challenges.

technology_delivery:4464363974.description:
**Aperçu**Chez KPMG au Canada, les employés sont appelés à mettre à profit leurs perspectives pour relever les plus grands défis du Canada. Ici, vous pouvez créer un élan qui dépasse notre organisation, développer des compétences de demain et prendre votre carrière en main, et ce, avec du soutien à chaque étape. Joignez-vous à un cabinet où votre carrière peut vraiment faire une différence.  

Nous recherchons une ou un Senior Consultant spécialisé en gestion des risques liés aux tiers (Third-Party Risk Management – TPRM) pour rejoindre notre pratique Gestion des risques technologiques, au sein du groupe Cybersécurité – Gouvernance, Stratégie et Transformation.  

Dans ce rôle, vous accompagnerez nos clients dans la conception, l’amélioration et l’opérationnalisation de leurs programmes de gestion des risques liés aux tiers. Vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des tiers, de l’identification et l’évaluation des risques jusqu’au suivi, à la remédiation et à l’amélioration continue des dispositifs TPRM.  

**Ce que vous ferez**Accompagner nos clients dans l’évaluation, la transformation et l’opérationnalisation de leurs programmes de gestion des risques liés aux tiers. Vous combinez une vision stratégique, une compréhension des risques et une capacité à structurer l'exécution. Vous savez adapter votre discours aux équipes techniques comme aux membres de la direction.  

**Gestion des risques liés aux tiers**

- Concevoir ou faire évoluer les cadres de gouvernance TPRM, politiques, standards, rôles et responsabilités, processus et mécanismes de contrôle.
- Analyser et optimiser le cycle de vie des tiers, de l’entrée en relation jusqu'à la fin de la relation.
- Traduire les exigences métier et de risque en besoins fonctionnels et contribuer à la conception de workflows, questionnaires, modèles de risque, règles de gestion et mécanismes de suivi.
- Contribuer à la sélection, la conception, la configuration fonctionnelle ou au déploiement de solutions technologiques supportant les processus TPRM.

**Gouvernance, stratégie et risques**

- Réaliser des diagnostics de maturité, des analyses de risques et des revues de conformité, puis formuler des recommandations priorisées et actionnables.
- Élaborer des stratégies cyber, des modèles opératoires cibles et des feuilles de route alignés sur les objectifs métier, l'appétence au risque et les capacités de l'organisation.
- Définir ou faire évoluer les politiques, standards, cadres de contrôle, rôles et responsabilités, mécanismes de gouvernance, indicateurs et tableaux de bord destinés aux instances de direction.

**Transformation, réalisation et développement de la pratique**

- Piloter des volets de mission, planifier les travaux, animer les ateliers, coordonner les parties prenantes et assurer la qualité des livrables.
- Accompagner le changement, l'adoption de nouvelles pratiques et, au besoin, la sélection ou le déploiement de solutions GRC.
- Analyser les capacités organisationnelles, les coûts et les occasions d'optimisation; contribuer à l'encadrement de consultants moins expérimentés.
- Participer au développement commercial de la pratique propositions, appels d'offres, soutenances, développement d'offres et partage de connaissances.

**Ce que vous apportez au rôle**

- Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieurs, d’un troisième cycle en systèmes d’information, cybersécurité ou gestion des risques, ou titulaire d’un baccalauréat en administration des affaires, notamment avec une concentration en technologies de l’information, ou d’une formation équivalente.
- Vous justifiez de 3 à 5 ans d'expérience pertinente en conseil ou en organisation, sur des mandats de cybersécurité, risques technologiques, ou gestion des risques liés aux tiers.
- Vous possédez une bonne compréhension des principes et du cycle de vie de la gestion des risques liés aux tiers (TPRM).
- Vous avez de l’expérience en évaluation des risques, gouvernance, conception ou amélioration de processus et formulation de recommandations.
- Vous connaissez plusieurs référentiels ou pratiques reconnus, par exemple ISO 27001/27005, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, COBIT, ISO 22301 ou des cadres de gouvernance et de protection des données.
- Vous êtes à l'aise pour structurer une problématique, faciliter des ateliers, produire des livrables de grande qualité et présenter des recommandations à des interlocuteurs exécutifs.
- Vous savez gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle, travailler dans des environnements complexes et accompagner le changement avec rigueur, pragmatisme et sens du collectif.
- Vous possédez d'excellentes compétences de communication orale et écrite en français et en anglais.
- Des certifications telles que CISM, CRISC, CISSP, ISO 27001/27005, ISO 22301, CBCI/CBCP, CDPSE, CIPM ou équivalent constituent un atout.

**Nos valeurs, la façon KPMG****Intégrité**, nous faisons ce qui est juste | **Excellence**, nous ne cessons jamais d’apprendre et de nous améliorer | **Courage**, nous pensons et agissons avec audace | **Ensemble**, nous nous respectons les uns les autres et puisons notre force dans nos différences | **Pour le mieux**, nous faisons en sorte que notre travail compte  

KPMG au Canada souscrit fièrement au principe de l’égalité d’accès à l’emploi et s’engage à offrir un environnement de travail respectueux, inclusif et sans obstacle, permettant ainsi à tous les membres de son personnel de se réaliser pleinement. Un effectif diversifié est la clé de notre réussite et nous croyons à notre mission qui vise à ce que vous soyez complètement vous-même au travail. Nous invitons tous les candidats qualifiés à se manifester et nous espérons que vous ferez de KPMG au Canada votre employeur de choix.  

**Ajustements et mesures d’adaptation tout au long du processus de recrutement**Chez KPMG, nous nous engageons à favoriser un processus de recrutement inclusif qui permet à tout le monde d’être soi-même et d’exceller. Nous visons à offrir une expérience positive et sommes prêts à fournir des ajustements et des mesures d’adaptation pour vous aider à donner le meilleur de vous-même. Les ajustements (demande non officielle), comme du temps de préparation supplémentaire ou la possibilité de prendre de courtes pauses pendant les entrevues, et les mesures d’adaptation (demande officielle), comme des moyens de communication accessibles ou des aides technologiques, sont adaptés aux besoins individuels et aux exigences de poste. Il est possible de demander des ajustements ou des mesures d’adaptation à tout moment du processus de recrutement. Si vous avez besoin d’aide, communiquez avec l’équipe du Service des relations avec les employés de KPMG au 1-888-466-4778.  

**Utilisation IA**Nous avons recours à l’intelligence artificielle (IA) pour améliorer l’expérience des candidats et simplifier nos processus de recrutement. Les outils d’IA peuvent aider à organiser les candidatures ou à faire ressortir les qualifications pertinentes. Toutefois, aucune décision d’embauche n’est prise à l’aide de l’IA. Toutes les décisions d’embauche sont prises par nos gestionnaires recruteurs et nos professionnels du recrutement, qui ont reçu une formation leur permettant d’utiliser ces outils de façon responsable. Les technologies d’IA utilisées dans notre processus de recrutement font l’objet d’évaluations détaillées des risques, qui tiennent compte des exigences en matière de sécurité et de confidentialité, en phase avec le cadre d’IA de confiance de KPMG.  

Nous croyons que la technologie devrait renforcer le jugement humain, et non le remplacer. Voilà l’une des nombreuses façons dont nous concrétisons notre vision, c’est-à-dire être un cabinet qui priorise la technologie, mais qui demeure axé sur les gens.

À propos de Highspring

Highspring est une firme de services-conseils et de services professionnels de nouvelle génération. Nous accompagnons les organisations dans leurs initiatives stratégiques en transformation numérique, cybersécurité, données, assurance qualité et modernisation technologique. Grâce à une approche agile, collaborative et orientée vers les résultats, nous aidons nos clients à relever leurs défis les plus complexes tout en générant un impact d'affaires durable.

L'opportunité

Highspring est à la recherche d'un(e) **Scrum Master** expérimenté(e) pour soutenir ses clients dans l'adoption, l'évolution et l'optimisation de leurs pratiques Agile.

À titre de consultant(e), vous travaillerez étroitement avec des équipes multidisciplinaires, des Product Owners et diverses parties prenantes afin de favoriser une livraison efficace de produits et de projets tout en contribuant à l'amélioration continue des équipes et des processus organisationnels.

Vous jouerez également un rôle important dans les initiatives de transformation Agile et dans le développement d'une culture de collaboration, de transparence et d'excellence opérationnelle.

Ce que vous ferez

- Animer les cérémonies Agile, notamment les Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews et Rétrospectives.
- Accompagner les équipes dans l'application des principes, valeurs et pratiques Agile.
- Soutenir les Product Owners dans la gestion, l'organisation et la priorisation du backlog.
- Assurer le suivi des livrables, des engagements de sprint et des indicateurs de performance de l'équipe.
- Identifier, documenter et aider à résoudre les obstacles, risques et dépendances pouvant affecter la livraison.
- Favoriser une collaboration efficace entre les équipes de livraison, les gestionnaires et les parties prenantes.
- Animer des ateliers de travail, des séances de planification et des activités d'amélioration continue.
- Conseiller les clients sur les meilleures pratiques Agile et les approches de livraison adaptées à leur contexte.
- Participer aux initiatives de transformation organisationnelle et à l'amélioration de la maturité Agile.
- Préparer et présenter des rapports d'avancement aux différentes parties prenantes.
- Agir comme agent de changement en promouvant une culture axée sur la collaboration, la transparence et l'amélioration continue.
- Développer et maintenir des relations de confiance avec les clients et les équipes de projet.

Ce que vous apportez à la table

- Minimum de 4 années d'expérience à titre de Scrum Master.
- Expérience démontrée dans des environnements Agile complexes.
- Expérience en services-conseils ou en services professionnels auprès de clients externes.
- Excellentes aptitudes de communication, d'animation et de facilitation.
- Capacité reconnue à influencer, mobiliser et accompagner des équipes multidisciplinaires.
- Forte orientation client et excellentes habiletés relationnelles.
- Bilinguisme français et anglais, tant à l'oral qu'à l'écrit.

Compétences clés requises

- Capacité à suivre et analyser les indicateurs de performance Agile.
- Expérience dans la gestion des risques, dépendances et enjeux de livraison.
- Solides compétences en coaching Agile et en amélioration continue.
- Aptitude à évoluer dans des environnements dynamiques et à forte visibilité.
- Bilinguisme requis ( angalis/ français)

Notre environnement

- Méthodologies Agile : Scrum, Kanban et pratiques Agile à grande échelle.
- Outils de gestion : Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps.
- Collaboration avec des équipes multidisciplinaires dans des contextes de transformation numérique.

Pourquoi joindre Highspring?

- Collaborer avec une équipe dynamique de consultants et d'experts de haut calibre.
- Participer à des projets stratégiques et à fort impact pour des organisations de premier plan.
- Profiter d'occasions de formation continue, de perfectionnement professionnel et de certifications.
- Évoluer dans une culture collaborative qui valorise l'innovation, l'agilité et le leadership.
- Bénéficier d'un environnement de travail flexible favorisant l'équilibre entre la vie professionnelle et personnelle.

**Biotech Health Data Governance Lead (AI Training)****About The Role**What if your expertise in biotech data governance could directly shape how AI understands and works with clinical research data — influencing discoveries that affect millions of patients worldwide? We're looking for a Biotech Health Data Governance Lead to ensure that research and clinical trial data is accurate, traceable, compliant, and ready to power cutting-edge AI models and regulatory submissions.  

This is a fully remote, flexible contract role built for experienced professionals in life sciences, clinical research, or regulated data environments. If you've spent your career making sure critical data is trustworthy and audit-ready, this is your opportunity to bring that expertise to the frontier of AI.  

- Organization: Alignerr
- Type: Hourly Contract
- Location: Remote
- Commitment: 10–40 hours/week

**What You'll Do**

- Govern biotech research and clinical trial data to ensure accuracy, lineage, and full auditability for scientific analysis and regulatory submissions
- Define and enforce data policies covering classification, access controls, security standards, and metadata management across research, clinical, regulatory, and partner teams
- Enable secure, governed data access for analytics, innovation pipelines, and external collaborations — while protecting confidential and patient-related information
- Evaluate and improve data quality frameworks used to support AI model training in life sciences contexts
- Collaborate with scientific, IT, compliance, and business stakeholders to align data standards, workflows, and governance practices

**Who You Are**

- Experienced in leading or implementing data governance programs within biotech, life sciences, clinical research, or another regulated data environment
- Deeply familiar with data privacy, security, and compliance requirements — including regulatory expectations for clinical trial and research data
- Skilled at working across cross-functional teams — from bench scientists to IT architects to compliance officers
- Detail-oriented and systematic, with a track record of building trustworthy, audit-ready data ecosystems
- Comfortable working independently in a remote, asynchronous environment

**Nice to Have**

- Prior experience with data annotation, data quality evaluation, or AI training data pipelines
- Familiarity with regulatory frameworks such as FDA 21 CFR Part 11, ICH E6 GCP, or HIPAA
- Background in data architecture, metadata management, or master data management in a life sciences context
- Experience working with or evaluating AI/ML datasets in research or clinical settings

**Why Join Us**

- Work at the intersection of life sciences and cutting-edge AI — a rare and genuinely exciting opportunity
- Fully remote and flexible — structure your work around your life, not the other way around
- Freelance autonomy with meaningful, substantive project work that draws on your deepest expertise
- Contribute to AI initiatives that support real scientific discovery and better health outcomes
- Collaborate with world-class AI research teams and life sciences organizations
- Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as projects evolve

**Client:** Supply Ontario  

**Job Type:** Hybrid – 3 Days Onsite  

**Work Location:** Metro Hall, 55 John Street, Toronto, Ontario, Canada  

**Start Date:** September 28, 2026  

**End Date:** March 28, 2027  

**Business Days:** 130  

**Hours:** 7.25 hours per day, 5 days per week  

**Anticipated Duration:** 6 months  

**Potential Extension:** 6 months  

**Public Sector Experience:** Preferred  

Application Deadline  

**Tuesday, September 8, 2026 at 9:00 AM EST**Role Overview  

Supply Ontario is seeking a **Senior UX Designer** with extensive experience in user experience, interaction, product, or service design to support complex digital products and services.  

The successful candidate will lead discovery, user research, interaction design, prototyping, accessibility, design-system alignment, stakeholder engagement, and implementation support. The role requires strong proficiency with **Figma**, experience with **AODA and WCAG**, and the ability to design accessible, responsive, user-centred digital experiences.  

**Must-Have Skills & Experience**

- Minimum 7 years of professional experience in UX, UI, interaction, product, or service design, including senior-level responsibility for complex digital products or services.
- Extensive experience planning and conducting:

- Discovery
- User research
- Stakeholder interviews
- Usability testing
- Evidence synthesis

- Ability to translate research findings into prioritized design recommendations.
- Extensive experience creating:

- User journeys
- Task flows
- Service blueprints
- Information architecture
- Wireframes
- Interactive prototypes
- High-fidelity responsive designs

- Experience designing for both web and mobile services.
- Advanced proficiency with Figma, including:

- Components
- Variants
- Libraries
- Prototyping
- File organization
- Documentation
- Developer handoff

- Experience designing and documenting accessible digital experiences in accordance with AODA and applicable WCAG requirements.
- Experience contributing to, extending, and applying design systems, including:

- Reusable components
- Patterns
- Tokens
- Interaction guidance
- Content guidance
- Governance practices

**Required Experience**

- Experience designing complex public-facing or enterprise digital services, including:

- Navigation
- Search
- Forms
- Validation
- Error handling
- Empty states
- Loading states
- Other relevant interaction states

- Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, including:

- Researchers
- Content specialists
- Accessibility specialists
- Developers
- Product and project leads
- Business stakeholders
- Senior decision-makers

- Experience facilitating:

- In-person and remote workshops
- Design critiques
- Playback sessions
- Decision-making activities

- Ability to build consensus and present recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Experience preparing implementation-ready specifications and supporting developer handoff.
- Experience participating in design-quality reviews and resolving design and accessibility issues during implementation.
- Strong written, verbal, facilitation, analytical, organizational, and stakeholder-management skills.

Portfolio Requirements  

The proposal must include a **portfolio or case studies demonstrating at least three relevant projects**.  

**Each Example Should Identify**

- Candidate's role and responsibilities.
- Project context, users, constraints, and objectives.
- Research and design methods used.
- Key design decisions and supporting evidence.
- Accessibility and inclusive-design considerations.
- Collaboration and implementation approach.
- Measurable outcomes, lessons learned, or resulting improvements.

**Note:** The City may request the candidate to present selected case studies during the interview.  

Experience Considered an Asset  

- Post-secondary education or certification in:

- User Experience Design
- Interaction Design
- Service Design
- Human-Computer Interaction
- Information Architecture
- Accessibility
- Related discipline

- Experience delivering digital services in a:

- Municipal environment
- Broader public-sector environment
- Regulated environment

- Experience with content design, search optimization, analytics, or service performance measurement.
- Experience providing coaching, mentorship, or knowledge transfer to design teams and multidisciplinary partners.
- Familiarity with Agile product delivery.
- Familiarity with public-sector procurement or governance processes.

Key Responsibilities  

Discovery & Research  

- Plan and conduct discovery, user research, stakeholder interviews, usability testing, and related evidence-gathering activities.
- Review existing research, analytics, service processes, accessibility findings, business requirements, and technical constraints.
- Synthesize findings into prioritized user needs, experience principles, design recommendations, risks, and opportunities.
- Ensure research and design activities include diverse users and consider accessibility, privacy, ethics, and informed consent requirements.

Experience & Interaction Design  

- Translate validated user and business needs into:

- User journeys
- Task flows
- Service blueprints
- Information architecture
- Wireframes
- Prototypes
- High-fidelity interface designs

- Design responsive and accessible experiences for web and mobile.
- Design navigation, forms, validation, errors, empty states, loading states, and other relevant interaction states.
- Apply user-centred design methods and UX/UI best practices to improve usability, findability, task completion, consistency, and service outcomes.
- Identify and prioritize design debt and recommend practical improvements based on user impact, accessibility, feasibility, and project priorities.
- Iterate designs based on research findings, usability testing, stakeholder feedback, technical input, and implementation constraints.

Accessibility & Design-System Alignment  

- Design in accordance with applicable City standards, the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA), and applicable WCAG requirements.
- Document accessibility requirements, interaction behaviours, content guidance, and identified issues throughout the design process.
- Contribute to and support the maintenance of the City's design system.
- Create or refine reusable components, patterns, variants, tokens, and usage guidance.
- Reuse approved City components and patterns where appropriate.
- Document the rationale for proposed deviations or new patterns.
- Participate in accessibility and design reviews.
- Support resolution or formal acceptance of identified accessibility and design issues.

Collaboration & Implementation Support  

- Collaborate with City staff, divisional partners, researchers, content specialists, developers, product and project leads, and other stakeholders.
- Plan and facilitate workshops, design critiques, playback sessions, and decision-making activities.
- Build shared understanding and obtain timely stakeholder feedback.
- Present design concepts, research findings, prototypes, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
- Prepare developer-ready:

- Design specifications
- Annotated prototypes
- Assets
- Behaviours
- Responsive guidance
- Component references
- Acceptance criteria

- Maintain continuous involvement during implementation.
- Participate in design-quality reviews and document issues through resolution.
- Advise clients and project teams on UX, UI, service design, accessibility, and design-system standards.

Leadership, Documentation & Knowledge Transfer  

- Provide senior design leadership and advocate for evidence-based, accessible, consistent, and user-centred decision-making.
- Maintain:

- Design files
- Research records
- Decision logs
- Accessibility issue logs
- Design backlogs
- Other required documentation

- Identify and communicate design risks, dependencies, assumptions, scope impacts, and trade-offs.
- Monitor relevant UX, accessibility, service design, and technology practices.
- Recommend appropriate improvements for City consideration.
- Provide knowledge transfer, coaching, and documentation to enable City staff to maintain and extend the work.
- Perform related duties within the scope of the assignment as directed by the designated City authority.

Deliverables  

- Discovery and UX Assessment: Review existing research, analytics, service processes, accessibility findings, and design-system assets and deliver a prioritized findings report.
- Research Plan and Findings: Prepare research plans, participant criteria, consent materials, interview/usability-test scripts, and research synthesis with evidence and prioritized recommendations.
- User Journeys & Information Architecture: Produce current- and future-state journey maps, task flows, service blueprints where appropriate, sitemap/navigation recommendations, and content/findability improvements.
- Interaction Design & Prototypes: Deliver annotated wireframes and responsive, high-fidelity Figma designs for prioritized journeys, including error, validation, empty, loading, mobile, keyboard, and assistive-technology states.
- Design-System Contributions: Deliver reusable components, patterns, variants, tokens, interaction guidance, content guidance, accessibility requirements, and usage documentation.
- Usability Validation: Conduct iterative usability testing and deliver test reports documenting findings, severity, design changes, unresolved issues, and recommended next steps.
- Accessibility Assurance: Complete accessibility reviews against applicable City standards, AODA requirements, and current WCAG requirements specified by the City.
- Developer-Ready Design Handoff: Provide organized Figma files, specifications, assets, behaviours, responsive guidance, component references, and acceptance criteria.
- Stakeholder Engagement & Decision Records: Facilitate workshops, critiques, playback sessions, and approvals while maintaining decision logs.
- Design Backlog & Progress Reporting: Maintain a prioritized UX backlog covering research, design debt, accessibility, component work, and unresolved product decisions.
- Knowledge Transfer & Close-Out: Deliver editable source files, research records, approved designs, design-system documentation, backlog, decision log, known issues, recommendations, and knowledge-transfer sessions.

Mandatory Documents  

**Candidates Must Provide The Following Documents**

- Updated Resume in Word Format – Mandatory
- Skills Matrix and References – Mandatory
- Expected Hourly Rate – Mandatory

**Job#: 3050307****Job Description:**Data Center Project Manager  

**Location:** Canada (Remote with 50-100% travel)  

Role Overview  

The Data Center Project Manager will be responsible for managing a portfolio of Hardware Deployment Projects for external customers in their data center environments. This role involves leading technical resources to deploy hardware and providing ongoing communications to the customer, project team, and sales team. The Project Manager will track project status against plans, forecast and earn associated revenue, and notify management of issues and risks that could impact project delivery.

- Manage a portfolio of Hardware Deployment Projects.
- Lead technical resources to deploy hardware.
- Provide ongoing communications to the customer, project team, and sales team.
- Track project status against plans, forecast revenue, and manage project financials.
- Notify management of issues and risks that could potentially impact project delivery.
- Collaborate with a team of Project Managers for guidance on issues and procedures.
- Travel extensively (50%-100%) across Canada and potentially the United States, working onsite in customer data centers.

**Required Qualifications****Experience:** A minimum of 5+ years of IT Project Management experience supporting infrastructure deployment projects is required. Candidates must have recent hands-on project management experience involving Data Center Deployments, Enterprise Networking, High-Performance Computing (HPC), and Server and Storage Infrastructure. Experience managing customer-facing projects and interacting directly with executive and technical stakeholders is necessary.  

**Skills:** Candidates must possess a strong understanding of project management methodologies, processes, and controls. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, along with strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, are required. The ability to work with limited supervision to achieve project objectives is essential. A results-oriented mindset with strong attention to quality and customer satisfaction is also needed.  

**Qualifications**

- A Bachelor's Degree is preferred.
- Experience with Networking and/or High-Performance Computing (HPC).
- Canadian Citizenship is highly preferred for potential cross-border travel.

Work Environment  

This position requires a commitment to travel up to 50-100% of the time. Travel may be to various locations with diverse weather conditions, from hot, desert-like environments to very cold northern climates, particularly during winter in Canada.  

Travel costs will be reimbursed. The standard rotation is two weeks onsite followed by one week remote, though longer stays may be an option.

**Join us as we change healthcare for the better.**

OceanMD, a WELL Health Company, is the leading provider of EMR-integrated Patient Engagement and eReferral tools in Canada, playing a critical role in millions of patient visits and thousands of referrals every week. Our digital healthcare solutions empower patients and physicians to overcome the barriers preventing the timely delivery of healthcare services. By replacing paper forms with digital tools, we give patients and providers secure ways to connect, share health information, and update patient records. Our tools:

- Empower patients to share health information with their physician before, during, and after visits, helping to ensure health records are up to-date and accurate while improving patient care.
- Meet the growing demand for digital solutions with online booking and secure messaging that improves the patient’s experience, reduces the need for unnecessary phone calls, and makes clinics more efficient.
- Improve access to care by replacing faxes, displaying wait times, and reducing the time to process and access specialist referrals.

**Who we need**

Reporting to the Sr. Director, Government Program Services, and working closely with the Senior Program Account Manager, we are adding a Program Account Manager, Provincial Programs to our team. You will support the successful delivery of provincial digital health programs by coordinating action items and deliverables, maintaining project documentation, gathering information from teams across OceanMD, and helping ensure commitments, risks, and decisions are tracked and communicated. The Senior Program Account Manager will retain primary accountability for program strategy and senior client relationships, while you help translate priorities into coordinated plans and consistent execution.

*This is an existing, full-time, hybrid role requiring work in the office 2-3 days per week and travel within Canada as needed.*

**Who you are**

You are an organized and analytical program professional who enjoys turning complex discussions into clear actions and measurable progress. You bring experience coordinating cross-functional initiatives, managing documentation and deliverables, and gathering the information stakeholders need to make decisions. You are comfortable following up across teams, identifying gaps or roadblocks, and escalating issues appropriately. You thrive in an environment where no two days are alike and are motivated by the opportunity to improve healthcare through technology. Experience in healthcare, government, or technology environments would be an asset.

**What's in it for you**

*Impact and influence.* You want to make a difference in how Canadians experience the healthcare system and empower patients and physicians with the technology they need to streamline access to information.

*A place to grow your career and your skills.* You will immerse yourself in learning about what we do, understanding the impact we make on the lives of Canadians - established and new, young and old - as we bring an empowering service to them. We are looking for individuals who want to commit to our work, take our offerings to the next level and beyond, and help us grow as a company. In turn, as we continue to scale, we will take you on the journey with us, with opportunities for professional development, recognition, and growth.

*Learning and exposure.* You will work closely with an experienced senior program leader and cross-functional teams, gaining exposure to large-scale provincial digital health programs. You will have opportunities to strengthen your program management, business analysis, and client-facing skills while contributing to how the Government Program Services team operates as it grows.

**How you will make an impact**

- **Support program delivery.** Working closely with the Senior Program Account Manager, you will coordinate activities that support provincial program commitments, implementation plans, and client deliverables.
- **Track actions and deliverables.** You will maintain project plans, action logs, decision records, risks, issues, dependencies, and status reports. You will follow up with owners to keep work moving and escalate concerns when needed.
- **Gather and analyze information.** You will work across OceanMD's Product, Integrations, Support, Education, Finance, Legal, and other teams to investigate questions, consolidate responses, and prepare clear recommendations or briefing materials.
- **Coordinate stakeholders.** You will organize meetings, prepare agendas and materials, capture decisions and next steps, and ensure stakeholders receive timely updates.
- **Support reporting and governance.** You will help prepare client updates, program dashboards, presentations, meeting packages, and other materials used in internal and external governance forums.
- **Identify risks and roadblocks.** You will monitor emerging issues, gather the relevant facts, assess potential impacts, and work with the Senior Program Account Manager and internal teams to identify next steps.
- **Improve program processes.** You will help develop templates, workflows, documentation standards, and reporting practices that make provincial program delivery more consistent and efficient.

**What you bring**

- **Relevant experience.** You have proven experience in program coordination, project delivery, business analysis, client delivery, account support, or a related role. Experience in healthcare technology, government programs, or another complex stakeholder environment is an asset.
- **Project coordination skills.** You have experience maintaining project plans, tracking actions and deliverables, documenting decisions, monitoring dependencies, and producing clear status updates.
- **Analytical skills.** You can investigate questions, bring together information from multiple sources, identify gaps and risks, and translate complex details into concise summaries and practical recommendations.
- **Communication skills.** You communicate clearly and professionally in writing, meetings, presentations, and stakeholder updates. You are comfortable following up with colleagues at different levels of the organization.
- **Organization and follow-through.** You manage competing priorities, maintain accurate documentation, meet deadlines, and ensure commitments do not get lost between teams.
- **Collaboration and adaptability.** You build productive working relationships, seek input from subject-matter experts, and know when to resolve an issue independently and when to escalate it. You work with a sense of urgency and thrive in an evolving environment.
- **Technical skills.** You are proficient with Microsoft Office and project management or collaboration tools. You have experience preparing PowerPoint presentations, maintaining Excel-based trackers, and working with reporting data. Experience with the Ocean Platform is an asset.
- **Sector knowledge.** Exposure to digital health, provincial healthcare programs, government stakeholders, EMRs, HIS platforms, interoperability, or FHIR is an asset rather than a core requirement.
- **Purpose and values.** You are passionate about improving healthcare and interested in new ideas and technology. You share our commitment to ethical behaviour, accountability, respect, honesty, and integrity.

**Compensation**

The salary range for this position is $80k–$100k. The salary will be determined based on several factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and the needs of the organization. At OceanMD we are committed to fair and equitable compensation and aim to provide a competitive salary that reflects the value and expertise of the successful candidate.

**What you can expect from our interview process:**

- A virtual interview with a Talent Advisor discussing your interest in the role and the company and how you will make an impact as our new Program Account Manager. The conversation will be recorded using BrightHire, an AI-powered video interview tool. More details will be shared when you are invited to interview.
- A virtual interview with the Sr. Director, Government Program Services and the COO to learn about the role and future plans. You will be able to share your insights and experience and have time to ask questions about the company and the role.
- A final in-person interview with members of the Government Program Services team and the leadership team. This will be a chance for you to ask questions about the company's growth trajectory and how you will contribute as the new Program Account Manager.

**A note on values**

We value ethical behaviour above all else. We care about each other, and we respect each other as professionals and people. We treat our customers with respect and keep our word, even if it hurts. We own our mistakes. We strive for honesty and integrity every day in every situation. We look for people who share these values.

**We are transforming patient care across the country, and we’ve only just begun. Join us**

We are always on the lookout for ethically driven, intelligent, and compassionate professionals who want to be part of an energetic culture and company, people who are interested in contributing their talents in a challenging, interdisciplinary environment. If you feel you meet 70% of the qualifications we are looking for and are determined to make a difference, we encourage you to apply. We promise to consider your application fully.

**Express your interest here, explore what we do here, or follow us on LinkedIn to stay connected.**

We strive to build a diverse team and encourage applications from traditionally underrepresented groups. If we can make this easier through accommodation in the recruitment process, please let us know.

MatchBox Consulting Group is seeking a Project Manager on behalf of our client for a 1-year contract opportunity in Edmonton.  

The Project Manager will support a transmission program delivering multiple high-voltage infrastructure projects, including the construction of new assets and replacement of existing transmission infrastructure. This role is responsible for the full project lifecycle, from project inception and planning through procurement, construction, and close-out.  

The ideal candidate will bring strong construction project management experience, preferably within utilities, electrical transmission, or energized substation environments. This role requires someone comfortable managing multiple projects while overseeing budgets, schedules, procurement, safety, stakeholder coordination, project controls, and field execution.  

**Location:** Edmonton, AB  

**Job Type:** 1-year contract  

**Schedule:** Monday to Friday, 7:30am–4:00pm; hybrid work program  

**Responsibilities**

- Manage a portfolio of projects of varying size and complexity from project inception through project close-out.
- Support the safe execution of projects through hazard identification and safe work planning at all phases of the project.
- Ensure conformance with applicable Occupational Health and Safety legislation and internal HSE policies and procedures.
- Manage project budgets and maintain up-to-date project forecasts.
- Complete internal project and budget change approvals in a timely manner.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date project schedules.
- Coordinate with engineering, project controls, construction crews, and other internal stakeholders to support efficient project execution.

- Support major equipment and construction services procurement, including tendering, proposal evaluation, contract negotiations, and contract administration.
- Maintain accurate project records, reporting, and governance documentation.
- Work within project systems including Oracle Projects, IVARA Work Management, eScheduler, SharePoint, and ProjectWise.

- Complete required monthly time reporting and supporting documentation.

Nous avons une riche tradition d’engagement social et veillons à ce que nos employés aient la possibilité de s’investir au sein de leurs communautés. NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

**Job Description**

RESPONSABILITÉS

En tant que Responsable AQ (Assurance Qualité), vous serez chargé(e) de superviser la stratégie d’assurance qualité, de gérer les équipes AQ et de veiller à ce que les efforts de test soient alignés sur les objectifs du projet. Vous encadrerez les testeurs et analystes, collaborerez avec les développeurs et les équipes de production, et maintiendrez des normes élevées en matière de stabilité, de fonctionnalité et d’expérience joueur.

- Diriger, encadrer et soutenir les testeurs et analystes AQ afin de favoriser le développement de leurs compétences et leur efficacité.
- Attribuer les tâches de test, gérer les charges de travail et assurer une couverture adéquate des fonctionnalités et des jalons du projet.
- Examiner les rapports de bogues, les cas de test et la documentation afin de maintenir la clarté et la cohérence.
- Favoriser une culture axée sur la qualité, la communication et l’amélioration continue.
- Définir et maintenir les processus, normes et meilleures pratiques AQ à l’échelle du projet.
- Créer et superviser les plans de test, les cas de test et les évaluations des risques pour les systèmes et fonctionnalités majeurs.
- Collaborer avec l’équipe de production pour estimer l’étendue des activités AQ, planifier les ressources et suivre les risques liés à la qualité.
- Soutenir les tests d’intégration lors de l’ajout de nouveaux systèmes ou contenus.
- Utiliser les outils de débogage, les journaux (logs) et les fonctionnalités du moteur pour analyser les problèmes à un niveau technique plus approfondi.
- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les concepteurs, ingénieurs et producteurs afin de comprendre les objectifs des fonctionnalités et les contraintes techniques.
- Participer à la planification des sprints, aux réunions quotidiennes (stand-ups) et aux revues de fonctionnalités afin de rester aligné(e) sur l’avancement du développement.
- Communiquer clairement et de manière proactive les obstacles, les risques et les préoccupations liées à la qualité aux parties prenantes.
- Contribuer au maintien de la stabilité des versions grâce aux tests de fumée (smoke tests), aux contrôles de validation et à l’identification proactive des problèmes.
- Contribuer à l’amélioration des outils AQ, des tableaux de bord et des flux de travail afin d’accroître l’efficacité et la cohérence.

RESPONSIBILTIES

As the QA Lead, you will be responsible for overseeing the quality assurance strategy, managing QA teams, and ensuring that testing efforts align with project goals. You’ll guide testers and analysts, collaborate with developers and production, and maintain high standards for stability, functionality, and player experience.

- Lead, mentor, and support QA testers and analysts, helping them grow their skills and effectiveness.

- Assign testing tasks, manage workloads, and ensure coverage across features and milestones.

- Review bug reports, test cases, and documentation to maintain clarity and consistency.

- Foster a culture of quality, communication, and continuous improvement.

- Define and maintain QA processes, standards, and best practices across the project.

- Create and oversee test plans, test cases, and risk assessments for major systems and features.

- Partner with production to estimate QA scope, plan resources, and track quality‑related risks.

- Support integration testing when new systems or content are merged.

- Use debugging tools, logs, and engine features to investigate issues at a deeper technical level.

- Work closely with designers, engineers, and producers to understand feature goals and technical constraints.

- Participate in sprint planning, stand‑ups, and feature reviews to stay aligned with development progress.

- Communicate blockers, risks, and quality concerns clearly and proactively to stakeholders.

- Help maintain build stability through smoke tests, validation checks, and proactive issue identification.

- Contribute to improving QA tools, dashboards, and workflows to increase efficiency and consistency.

**Qualifications**

QUALIFICATIONS  

Exigences de base : 

- Expérience démontrée en assurance qualité dans le domaine du jeu vidéo, dont généralement 3 ans ou plus dans un rôle senior ou de leadership.

- Expérience significative en tests AQ, en analyse AQ ou dans des rôles AQ intégrés au développement de jeux vidéo.
- Solide compréhension des flux de travail et des outils de développement de jeux (Unity, Unreal ou moteurs propriétaires).
- Maîtrise des systèmes de suivi des bogues (Jira, DevTrack, Hansoft, etc.).
- Capacité à rédiger et à réviser des rapports de bogues clairs, concis et techniquement détaillés.
- Excellentes compétences en communication et aisance à travailler avec des équipes multidisciplinaires.
- Expérience démontrée en leadership ou en mentorat au sein d’une équipe AQ.
- Capacité à gérer les priorités de test dans un environnement dynamique et en évolution rapide.
- Participation à au moins un jeu publié ou à un ensemble majeur de fonctionnalités livrées.

Atouts recherchés : 

- Connaissance des systèmes de gestion de versions (Perforce, Git).
- Expérience avec les outils d’automatisation ou la création de scripts.
- Compréhension des tests de performance, du profilage ou de l’analyse de la mémoire.
- Connaissance des exigences de certification des consoles ou des tests spécifiques aux plateformes.
- Expérience dans la création ou l’amélioration de pipelines, d’outils ou de tableaux de bord AQ.

QUALIFICATIONS

Basic Requirements: 

- Proven experience in video game QA, often with 3+ years in a senior or lead role.
- Significant experience in QA testing, QA analysis, or embedded QA roles within game development.
- Strong understanding of game development workflows and tools (Unity, Unreal, or proprietary engines).

- Proficiency with bug‑tracking systems (Jira, DevTrack, Hansoft, etc.).

- Ability to write and review clear, concise, and technically detailed bug reports.

- Excellent communication skills and comfort working with cross‑disciplinary teams.

- Proven leadership or mentorship experience within QA.

- Ability to manage testing priorities in a fast‑paced environment.

- Experience contributing to at least one shipped game or major feature set.

Desired Characteristics: 

- Familiarity with version control systems (Perforce, Git).

- Experience with automation tools or scripting.

- Understanding of performance testing, profiling, or memory analysis.

- Knowledge of console certification requirements or platform‑specific testing.

- Experience building or improving QA pipelines, tools, or dashboards.

**Additional Information**

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. NBCUniversal's policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, gender identity or expression, age, national origin or ancestry, citizenship, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, membership in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead complex, customer-facing projects involving medium- and high-voltage equipment, rotating machinery, drive systems, power generation, and grid-support applications.

This position manages the full project lifecycle, including engineering, procurement, manufacturing, supplier coordination, logistics, installation, commissioning, customer acceptance, and final closeout. The Senior Project Manager will act as the primary customer contact while coordinating internal teams, vendors, subcontractors, and other project stakeholders.

The successful candidate will bring strong project leadership, technical understanding, commercial awareness, and the ability to manage high-value or high-risk projects with limited supervision.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Manage multiple complex projects from contract handoff through final completion and closeout.
- Serve as the primary point of contact for customers throughout project execution.
- Develop project schedules, milestones, communication plans, deliverables, and acceptance requirements.
- Lead project kickoff meetings, progress reviews, risk discussions, and closeout activities.
- Coordinate engineering, procurement, manufacturing, quality, logistics, field service, vendors, and subcontractors.
- Monitor project scope and manage changes, approvals, and contractual commitments.
- Resolve technical, commercial, scheduling, manufacturing, and operational challenges.
- Lead escalations requiring cross-functional coordination and senior-level decision-making.
- Track project financial performance, including costs, margins, forecasts, billing milestones, revenue, and cash flow.
- Review project performance against schedule, budget, quality, contractual, and customer expectations.
- Identify project and commercial risks and implement appropriate mitigation plans.
- Ensure compliance with contracts, internal procedures, regulatory requirements, customer specifications, and quality standards.
- Maintain accurate and auditable project documentation.
- Conduct customer meetings, supplier reviews, factory visits, and project-site visits when required.
- Lead lessons-learned reviews, corrective actions, root-cause investigations, and process-improvement initiatives.
- Support and mentor less-experienced project management personnel.
- Contribute to project management standards, operating procedures, and broader business objectives.

**Qualifications**

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Project Management, or a related discipline preferred.
- Equivalent technical education, professional certifications, and directly relevant experience may be considered.
- Approximately 8–12 years of relevant professional experience.
- At least 5 years of project management experience involving electrical equipment, rotating machinery, industrial manufacturing, energy systems, or major capital projects.
- Demonstrated success managing complex technical projects with direct customer interaction.
- PMP certification is preferred; comparable project management training and experience may be accepted.

**Knowledge and Skills**

- Strong understanding of electrical and industrial systems, including motors, generators, rotating equipment, power electronics, drive systems, or integrated energy equipment.
- Familiarity with applicable standards, such as NEMA, IEC, IEEE, and UL.
- Strong knowledge of project lifecycle management, scheduling, project controls, risk management, and change management.
- Experience using ERP and project management platforms; SAP knowledge is an asset.
- Strong commercial judgment and financial management skills.
- Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, presentation, and conflict-resolution abilities.
- Ability to manage several complex priorities and influence stakeholders without direct reporting authority.
- Strong analytical, organizational, planning, and decision-making skills.

**Secret****Exigences Linguistiques****Préférence sera accordée aux personnes bilingues****Date De Clôture****23/09/2026****Pays****Canada****Nous avons une opportunité passionnante à saisir dans la Région des services nationaux (RSN) !**Le spécialiste technique, Gestion des projets fournit des services de gestion de projets pour appuyer l’exécution des projets (d’un niveau de complexité faible à moyen) liés aux infrastructures et à l’environnement. Le titulaire du poste agit à titre de spécialiste technique auprès des clients-partenaires, et il peut également effectuer des recherches, des études et des évaluations.  

**Environnement de travail** Les programmes nationaux de niveau B (NLB) soutiennent les professionnels du ministère de la Défense nationale (MDN) à toutes les étapes des projets de l’Aviation royale canadienne (ARC) visant à moderniser, à renouveler et à mettre en place de nouvelles infrastructures clés essentielles. DCC apporte son soutien à divers projets liés aux aéronefs, aux drones, aux radars et aux infrastructures de soutien, afin de répondre aux besoins du Commandement de la défense aérospatiale de l'Amérique du Nord (NORAD). De l’identification et de l’analyse des problèmes à la planification, la conception et la construction, l’équipe du NLB recommande des approches de gestion des ressources, définit les objectifs et les stratégies du projet, et établit le calendrier ainsi que les indicateurs de performance.  

**ACTIVITÉS CLÉS ET PÉRIODIQUES****Voici une liste représentative, mais non exhaustive des tâches et des responsabilités liées au poste :****Tâches principales**

- Effectuer des recherches de même que préparer et présenter les documents requis (p. ex., approbations, énoncés des travaux, chartes de projet, budgets, politiques et procédures), dans le cadre de projets à long terme.
- Assurer la gestion complète, du lancement à la clôture, des projets liés aux infrastructures et à l’environnement, notamment les nouvelles constructions, les travaux de réfection, et les évaluations environnementales et les activités d’assainissement.
- Appuyer le processus d’approbation des projets des clients-partenaires en facilitant la prise de décisions au sein des organisations des clients-partenaires, notamment en participant à l’élaboration d’analyses de rentabilisation, d’analyses de l’espace fonctionnel et d’autres documents.
- Coordonner les communications avec les intervenants afin de garantir une prise de décisions en temps opportun.
- Participer à la planification de l’approvisionnement et préparer les documents d’appel d’offres.
- Coordonner les activités des experts-conseils.
- Agir à titre de représentant du directeur de projet ou du gestionnaire de projet, dans les limites de la délégation de pouvoir de signature de CDC.
- Établir et entretenir des relations efficaces au sein de la Société ainsi qu’avec l’industrie, les clients-partenaires et les intervenants.
- Veiller au respect des normes de qualité, conformément aux attentes de la Société et des clients-partenaires.

**Autres tâches**

Pour commencer une carrière à Construction de Défense Canada (CDC), vous devez être un citoyen canadien ou un résident permanent du Canada. À titre de condition d'emploi à CDC, il est nécessaire de détenir au minimum une cote de fiabilité. Certains rôles peuvent vous obliger à être titulaire d’une attestation de sécurité de niveau Secret.  

CDC est responsable du processus d’habilitation de sécurité du personnel. Généralement, pour être éligible pour une cote de « fiabilité », vous devez être en mesure de fournir des renseignements généraux vérifiables portant sur les cinq années précédentes, et pour être éligible pour une cote de sécurité de niveau « secret », vous devez être en mesure de fournir des renseignements généraux vérifiables portant sur les dix années précédentes. Ce processus comporte habituellement le contrôle des références ainsi que la vérification des compétences, du casier judiciaire et de la solvabilité (au besoin), et il peut nécessiter une prise des empreintes digitales. Pour plus de renseignements sur l’obtention d’une cote de sécurité, veuillez consulter la Norme sur le filtrage de sécurité .  

Il Est Essentiel De Posséder La Cote De Sécurité Appropriée Pour Obtenir Un Emploi à CDC. De Plus, Il Incombe Au Candidat Ou à L’employé De S’assurer Qu’il Peut Obtenir Et Conserver Le Niveau D’attestation De Sécurité Requis Pour Commencer Ou Maintenir Son Emploi à CDC. À Défaut D’obtenir Ou De Conserver Le Niveau D’attestation De Sécurité Requis, Le Candidat Ou L’employé Ne Recevra Pas D’offre D’emploi, L’offre Conditionnelle Sera Déclarée Nulle Et Non Avenue Ou Son Emploi Prendra Fin Par Suite D'un Licenciement Motivé. Pour Tous Les Candidats Et Employés, Le Processus D’attribution De La Cote De Sécurité Est Effectué à L’aide D’une Méthode Rigoureuse Qui Comprend Des Enquêtes, Des Vérifications Et Des Évaluations Relativement à Ce Qui Suit, Sans Toutefois S’y Limiter  

- le casier judiciaire
- les références
- les emplois précédents
- les sources ouvertes
- la situation crédit/financière

Le Code d'éthique (Code) de CDC est une condition d'emploi. Ceci accroît la confiance du public dans l'intégrité des employés de CDC et fournit des précisions aux employés sur certains problèmes, y compris les conflits d'intérêts réels ou potentiels. Avant de postuler ce poste (ou tout autre poste) à CDC, les candidats doivent se familiariser avec le Code. En effet, les nouveaux employés sont tenus d’attester avoir lu et compris le Code et de confirmer leur observation des exigences du Code dès le début de la période d’emploi à CDC. Les employés sont également tenus de revoir leurs obligations en vertu du Code et d'informer le Bureau du Président de tout changement dans leur situation le plus tôt possible et de remplir l'examen annuel une fois l'an.  

Faites partie d’un milieu de travail diversifié et inclusif!  

Les postes proposés par DCC nécessitent différents niveaux d'habilitation de sécurité, notamment « Fiabilité », « Secret », « Très Secret » et « Réservé aux Canadiens » (justificatif de nationalité requis). Bien que nous acceptions les candidatures de personnes qui ne sont pas de nationalité canadienne mais qui sont autorisées à travailler au Canada et justifient d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience vérifiable, la sélection dépendra des exigences spécifiques du poste concerné.  

Au sein de CDC, nous sommes déterminés à faire en sorte que chacun puisse s’exprimer et être authentique chez nous. Nous encourageons activement les candidatures de tous, notamment, mais sans s'y limiter, celles des femmes, des Autochtones, des personnes handicapées, des minorités visibles et des membres de la communauté LGBTQ2+.  

L’objectif de CDC est d’offrir aux employés et aux candidats un accès facile aux possibilités d’emploi et aux espaces de travail. Si vous avez besoin d’une mesure d’adaptation dans le cadre du processus de recrutement et/ou d’entrevue (documents dans un format autre, salles de conférences accessibles ou autre mesure), avisez-nous et nous travaillerons avec vous pour répondre à vos besoins . Pour toute demande de mesures d’adaptation, veuillez écrire à l’adresse careers@dcc-cdc.gc.ca .

Auxly is an international cannabis company dedicated to bringing innovative, effective, and high-quality cannabis products to the medical, wellness and adult-use markets. Auxly's experienced team of industry first-movers and enterprising visionaries have secured a diversified supply of raw cannabis, strong clinical, scientific, and operating capabilities and leading research and development infrastructure in order to create trusted products and brands in an expanding global market.  

Position Summary  

The Capital Projects & Construction Manager acts as the General Manager's delegate and owner's representative for the site's capital program, taking full ownership of capital project planning, prioritization, and execution. This position leads a continuous, multi-year pipeline of multi-million-dollar capital projects - including facility and warehouse expansions, major equipment installations, and greenfield/brownfield industrial construction - from initial concept and prioritization through design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover to operations.  

As the owner's representative, this individual coordinates and challenges consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders to protect the company's interests throughout each project, and builds enough working knowledge across engineering and technical disciplines (e.g. wastewater treatment, mechanical, electrical, civil, greenhouse/cultivation systems) to engage credibly with subject matter experts and stress-test the input they receive. This individual is not expected to be the engineer of record on any given discipline, but must be able to "talk the talk" and ask the right questions.  

The role is accountable for developing and defending project budgets and schedules, for managing contracts and contractor performance, and for translating technical and financial detail into clear recommendations and approval packages for the General Manager and corporate leadership.  

Key Relationships  

- General Manager (direct report) - primary partner on project prioritization, budget approval, and portfolio decisions.
- Corporate PMO - alignment on project governance, reporting standards, capital approval processes, and portfolio prioritization.
- QA / Validation (dotted line) - coordination on validation requirements for capital projects affecting regulated processes.
- Compliance Officer - coordination on site safety and regulatory (e.g. MoL) compliance during construction.
- External engineering consultants, contractors, and vendors.

Key Responsibilities  

- Own and maintain the site's multi-year capital project roadmap, including prioritization, lead times, budgets, and deliverable tracking.
- Evaluate and prioritize new capital initiatives in line with the site's growth and expansion strategy.
- Track progress across multiple concurrent projects and flag resource conflicts, schedule risk, or budget risk at the portfolio level.
- Ensure projects comply with corporate PMO methodologies, reporting standards, and stage-gate approval requirements.
- Provide the General Manager with regular, structured portfolio updates.

Project Execution  

- Develop project schedules, milestone plans, and cash flow forecasts; own project budgets with authority to develop, defend, and proactively accelerate variances.
- Coordinate engineering consultants and design partners; review drawings and specifications to ensure designs align with operational requirements; facilitate design review meetings with stakeholders.
- Develop project scopes and bid packages; support procurement activities and vendor selection.

Owner's Representation & Contract Management  

- Act as the owner's representative on capital projects, coordinating and challenging consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders to achieve project objectives and protect the company's interests.
- Lead contract negotiations and manage contractor performance throughout the project lifecycle.
- Manage change-order control, contractor claims, and commercial risk to protect project scope, schedule, and budget.

Regulatory & Permitting  

- Identify and manage provincial and municipal permitting requirements applicable to capital projects.
- Liaise with relevant regulatory authorities and authorities having jurisdiction as needed.
- Ensure capital projects meet applicable building codes and industry-specific regulatory requirements.

Construction Management  

- Coordinate all construction activities on site, including sequencing across trades and contractors.
- Ensure construction activities are executed in accordance with EHS requirements, contractor management programs, permitting requirements, and safe-work procedures, in coordination with the Compliance Officer on broader regulatory/EHS matters.
- Coordinate system testing and commissioning, including validations, in partnership with QA/Validation.
- Ensure all project documentation is completed.
- Facilitate operational handover and training.
- Ensure deficiencies are resolved before project closeout.

Stakeholder Synthesis & Leadership Reporting  

- Build sufficient technical fluency across relevant engineering disciplines to engage credibly with subject matter experts and evaluate the quality of their input.
- Identify and engage the right internal and external experts (consultants, engineers, contractors) to build a complete, accurate picture of each project's technical, cost, and risk profile.
- Develop financial analyses - including ROI, payback, and NPV assessments - to support capital investment decisions and business cases.
- Prepare and present clear, well-supported project updates and capital approval packages - including business case, cost/benefit, and risk - to the General Manager and corporate leadership.
- Translate technical and engineering detail into business-relevant language for non-technical stakeholders and decision-makers.

**Qualifications**

- Degree or Diploma in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or related discipline.
- 7-10+ years of progressive experience managing industrial capital projects and facility expansions, including facility/warehouse expansion, major equipment installations, manufacturing expansions, infrastructure upgrades, or greenfield/brownfield industrial projects valued at $5M-$50M+.
- Experience acting as an owner's representative on large capital projects, coordinating consultants, contractors, and internal stakeholders to achieve project objectives.
- Experience working with contractors, consultants, and procurement teams, including contract negotiation, change-order control, and claims management.
- Experience in regulated manufacturing, food, pharmaceutical, greenhouse, or cannabis environments.
- Experience with greenhouse/cultivation infrastructure systems (HVAC, irrigation, fertigation, power distribution, backup generation, wastewater treatment, automation and controls), warehousing, or logistics preferred.
- Demonstrated ability to work across multiple engineering and technical disciplines and translate complex technical information for non-technical audiences — this role requires broad working knowledge across disciplines rather than deep specialization in any one.
- Strong track record developing and presenting business cases, financial analyses (ROI, payback, NPV), budgets, and project recommendations to senior leadership.
- PMP, Gold Seal Certification, professional engineering designation (P.Eng.), Lean/Six Sigma, or Construction Management certification considered an asset.

Auxly is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We thank all applicants for their interest, however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted.
